title: RECRUITER
description:
1\. Job Purpose To manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process for SAGE University Indore by sourcing, screening, coordinating and facilitating the selection of suitable candidates for Teaching, Non\-Teaching, Administrative and Support positions, while ensuring timely fulfilment of manpower requirements and maintaining a strong candidate pipeline.

2\. Key Responsibilities

A. Recruitment Planning Understand manpower requirements received from HODs/HOIs and respective departments. Prepare recruitment plans based on approved vacancies and manpower requirements. Prioritize critical and long\-pending vacancies. Maintain an updated Recruitment Tracker / Vacancy Tracker.

B. Candidate Sourcing Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, employee referrals, recruitment databases, social media and other relevant channels. Develop and maintain a database of qualified faculty and staff candidates. Proactively search for candidates for difficult\-to\-fill academic and technical positions. Build a continuous talent pipeline for frequently required positions.

C. Resume Screening \& Shortlisting Screen CVs against approved Job Descriptions and eligibility criteria. Verify educational qualifications, experience, specialization and other position\-specific requirements. Shortlist suitable candidates and maintain accurate resume records. Conduct initial telephonic screening to assess candidate suitability, availability, salary expectations and interest.

D. Interview Coordination Contact shortlisted candidates and confirm their availability. Schedule interviews with HR, HOD/HOI and other competent authorities as per the University's recruitment process. Coordinate interview drives, walk\-in interviews and virtual interviews. Ensure candidates receive proper information regarding interview date, time, venue and required documents. Maintain an updated Interview Tracker and interview status.

E. Candidate Follow\-up Maintain regular communication with shortlisted candidates throughout the recruitment cycle. Follow up with candidates after interviews regarding their interest and joining availability. Maintain a database of selected, rejected, on\-hold and withdrawn candidates. Minimize candidate drop\-outs through timely and professional follow\-up.

F. Selection \& Offer Coordination Coordinate with HR Head and concerned authorities regarding final selection. Collect and verify required candidate documents. Coordinate offer/appointment documentation as per approved process. Maintain joining commitments and follow up until the candidate joins.

G. Recruitment MIS \& Reporting Prepare and submit regular recruitment reports covering: Total vacancies New vacancies received CVs received CVs shortlisted Candidates contacted Interviews scheduled Interviews conducted Candidates selected Offers released Candidates joined Candidates declined/withdrawn Vacancy ageing Source\-wise recruitment performance Position\-wise recruitment status H. Recruitment Targets The Recruiter shall work towards achieving: Timely closure of approved vacancies Maximum qualified CV sourcing against every vacancy Improved interview\-to\-selection ratio Improved offer\-to\-joining ratio Reduction in vacancy ageing Reduction in candidate drop\-outs Development of a strong candidate database Continuous pipeline for critical academic positions

I. Employer Branding \& Recruitment Outreach Support HR in promoting SAGE University as an employer of choice. Coordinate recruitment campaigns and hiring drives. Support LinkedIn and other digital recruitment initiatives. Develop relationships with professional networks, academic communities and relevant institutions for 4\.

4\. Required Qualification Minimum: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline. Preferred: MBA/PGDM in HR, Master's Degree in HR or a related discipline. 5\. Experience 2–5 years of relevant experience in recruitment / talent acquisition. Experience in higher education recruitment, faculty recruitment or institutional hiring will be preferred. Candidates having experience in bulk recruitment and recruitment drives will be given preference. 6\. Required Skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Excellent candidate sourcing skills Resume screening and interviewing skills Strong follow\-up and coordination ability Knowledge of LinkedIn and major job portals Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets Ability to maintain recruitment MIS and trackers Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills Ability to work with multiple departments simultaneously Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach Good understanding of recruitment confidentiality and professional ethics 7\. Preferred Behavioural Competencies Ownership \| Speed \| Persistence \| Communication \| Professionalism \| Coordination \| Confidentiality \| Result Orientation \| Candidate Focus 8\. Authority \& Accountability The Recruiter shall be responsible for the complete recruitment coordination cycle from vacancy requirement to candidate joining, while final selection and approval shall remain with the designated competent authorities of SAGE University Indore. 9\. Daily Recruitment Activities Review open vacancies. Check new CVs and applications. Source candidates for priority vacancies. Screen and shortlist CVs. Contact candidates telephonically. Schedule interviews. Follow up with interview candidates. Update Recruitment/Interview Tracker. Coordinate with HODs/HOIs and HR team. Submit recruitment status/MIS as required.

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

--------------------


Job Purpose


To ensure smooth execution of HR processes \& systems within the defined process \& TAT resulting in delighted, engaged and productive employees across the assigned region


Job Context \& Major Challenges


Job Context: To ensure smooth execution of HR processes \& systems within the defined process \& TAT resulting in delighted, engaged and productive employees across the assigned region  

  

Job Challenges: To institutionalize all HR practices and to create an engaged workforce by ensuring a performance oriented culture and to ensure HR delivers as a business partner in respective regions.


Key Result Areas

  

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Meet manpower requirement and provide all HR administrative support to new joinees as well as existing employees at the regions. RECRUITMENT:  

  

1\. Facilitate manpower hiring across the region is within Budget and as per approved manpower plan  

2\. Source all positions upto Manager level within TAT  

3\. Ensure quality of hire within the specified parameter  

4\. Close all critical positions in shortest possible time within the hiring budget  

5\. Ensure recruitments are done with an optimum sourcing mix to maintain cost within budget.  

6\. Ensure compensation alignment for all recruitments (within given bands) during the hiring process  


KRA2 Meet manpower requirement and provide all HR administrative support to new joinees as well as existing employees at the regions. HR OPERATIONS:  

  

1\. Provide functional direction \& ensure smooth \& uniform delivery of HR Ops issues pertaining to joining, compensation, exits etc across branches, regions \& verticals  

2\. Coordinate and resolve employee query with contact points in HR/ Payroll  

3\. Provide support/assistance for smooth transition to the shared services model and act as the first point of escalation for unresolved queries.  

  

ATTRITION MANAGEMENT:  

  

1\. Conduct structured exit interview for all exits upto Manager level and record the same.  

2\. Analyse attrition in the region and identify key reasons contributing maximum to the attrition numbers  

3\. Devise mechanisms, steps \& local initiatives (like skip levels, open house sessions etc) to address employee concerns \& arrest the factors contributing most to the attrition bucket.  

4\. Partner with BM/BH in counselling session of employees during branch visits in case of disciplinary/ attitudinal issues  


KRA3 Execute all OD initiatives \& other initiatives of corporate HR to achieve a highly engaged workforce at the zones. OD INTERVENTIONS/ INITIATIVES:  

  

1\. Conduct various employee engagement/fun initiatives/activities across the region from time to time  

2\. Emphasise on employee referral policy and encourage employees for enhanced participation  

3\. Guide BMs with the process of handling cases of indiscipline, abscondance, PIP \& other ER issues  

4\. Drive initiatives like Poornata, OHS action planning, Goal setting, Q12 etc. from time to time  

5\. Conduct structured induction program for all new joinees, immediately on joining.  


KRA4 Help the region in creating an environment of trust and to satisfactorily \& speedily resolution of any ER issues in the region. HR NORMS:  

  

1\. Ensure adherence to norms as per checklist (statutory and audit) while conducting branch visits.  

2\. Ensure escalation of non\-adherence cases and adopting measures for fast resolution.  

3\. Educate sales and support staff by addressing on various HR norms during branch visits in cases of non\-adherence.  

  

HANDLING ER ISSUES:  

  

1\. Ensure Code of conduct awareness among the employees in the region  

2\. Independently investigate any reported breach and to recommend course of action to be taken  

3\. Speedy and effective investigation of all cases in the region sent by alert and forward detailed report to the whistle blower committee.  

4\. Ensure spelling out SOPs on people practice in various communication forums (Meetings/workshops) creating a harmonious relation in the region.  


KRA5 Create a Learning environment in the assigned region. LEARNING:  

  

To receive feedback from Sales/Operations team identifying the learning requirements and prepare a PDP (Performance Development Planning) matrix facilitating online training/ workshop  

  

SELF DEVELOPMENT \-  

  

1\. Ensure discussion with immediate supervisor on areas of improvement and focus on development needs, if any  

2\. Ensure self learning through training programs, including participation in online programs from Adityadisha

title: P&C Business Partner (Bangalore candidates only)
description:
**Work Timings:** **5:30 PM to 2:30 AM**

**What You'll Do**

A successful People \& Culture Business Partner will partner with business leaders, managers, and employees to drive core People \& Culture processes, strengthen employee engagement, support employee lifecycle activities, and ensure consistent application of people practices aligned to business needs and organizational policies.


**Responsibilities**

**Policy Awareness \& Guidance** – Drive awareness and understanding of People \& Culture policies and processes among employees and managers. Provide timely guidance to ensure adherence, consistency, and clarity across the organization. Regularly support review and updates of internal SOPs and policy documents.


* **Employee Engagement \& Connects** – Conduct regular employee connects, manager interactions, and leadership sessions to understand employee concerns and improve engagement. Plan and execute engagement activities in collaboration with the People \& Culture team to build a positive work environment.
* **Performance Management** – Support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, and calibration. Guide managers on process expectations and best practices to ensure fairness, clarity, and timely completion of performance cycles.
* **Rewards \& Recognition** – Drive reward and recognition initiatives and support optimal utilization of approved budgets. Promote peer\-to\-peer recognition through available tools and programs to strengthen a culture of appreciation.
* **Employee Relations \& Grievance Handling** – Manage employee grievances and workplace concerns with sensitivity, confidentiality, and professionalism. Provide practical guidance and counselling support to employees and managers to help resolve issues effectively.
* **Exit Management** – Support employees and managers through exit processes, ensuring smooth, timely, and compliant completion of exit formalities while maintaining a positive employee experience.
* **Compliance \& Training** – Drive completion of mandatory compliance trainings within defined timelines. Partner with business teams to support adherence to statutory, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
* **Reporting** – Maintain accurate organization structures, span of control data, and People \& Culture documentation. Prepare reports, trackers, and presentations for leadership and business reviews as required.
* **Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement** – Facilitate leadership connects and People \& Culture process or tool orientations for business leaders. Partner with stakeholders to align People \& Culture initiatives with business priorities.
* **Early Warning** **\& Risk Identification** –Support proactive identification of risks related to attrition, engagement, performance, and employee concerns. Work with managers to identify corrective actions and follow through on agreed plans.
* **New Hire Integration** – Conduct new employee orientation sessions and new hire connects to ensure smooth onboarding, integration, and early engagement within the organization.
* **Internal Talent Movement** – Manage Internal Job Posting processes for key roles, ensuring a transparent, timely, and business\-aligned process for internal talent movement.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**
========================================

* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field preferred.
* 4 to 6 years of total work experience, including relevant HR Business Partner or People \& Culture Business Partner exposure.
* Strong understanding of People \& Culture processes including employee relations, employee engagement, performance management, onboarding, exits, and policy guidance.
* Good communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with employees, managers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with confidentiality, professionalism, and sound judgement.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

**What You May Need to be Successful:**

* Experience handling employee lifecycle processes in a dynamic business environment.
* Demonstrated success in supporting engagement initiatives, compliance trainings, employee relations matters, and performance management cycles.
* Collaborative approach with strong stakeholder management and follow\-through skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR or People \& Culture systems.
* Ability to work predominantly office\-based schedules, including night shift requirements, where applicable to the business.

description:
**Job Title: HR Intern**  

**Location:** Trichy  

  

**Experience:** Freshers / Ongoing MBA or Master’s in HR (Preferred)  

  

**Reports to:** Founder  

  

**About Frigate:**
Frigate is a B2B manufacturing execution company. We take products from development to serial production — NPD, contract manufacturing and second\-source programs — through a network of 33 committed manufacturing partners selected from over 900 qualified Indian suppliers, serving customers across 19 export markets. Our focus segments: energy, power electronics, EV charging and precision manufacturing.  

  

**The Role:*** You build the engine.
* Your job is to support the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle and employee engagement to keep Frigate growing fast.
* You do not set strategic policy; you find great candidates, screen for alignment, schedule interviews, and ensure smooth operations from sourcing to onboarding.

 **What you'll do daily:*** Source profiles from job portals, LinkedIn, and campus databases based on active job mandates.
* Conduct initial phone screening to verify basic details: location, notice period, and CTC expectations.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews between shortlisted candidates and hiring managers.
* Track candidate pipelines daily and update internal recruitment trackers — no exceptions.
* Assist in onboarding documentation, background verification checks, and employee file management.
* Drive internal employee engagement activities and coordinate festive or team events.
* Assist management with monthly payroll data compilation and attendance tracking.

 **Targets:** 40\+ profiles sourced/week 15\+ initial screenings/week 4\-5 final round interviews coordinated/week. **Must have:*** Strong operational discipline — you update candidate trackers daily without being chased.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* High bias for action and phone stamina — you are comfortable making multiple screening calls daily.
* People\-first attitude with the ability to maintain strict confidentiality on employee records.

 **Good to have:*** Familiarity with modern job portals
* Prior internship experience in an HR or recruitment agency environment.
* Basic knowledge of LinkedIn sourcing techniques.

**Location:** Uttar Pradesh – Balrampur / Siddharthnagar / Bhinga

**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** HR / Admin Lead

Job Summary

The Operations \& Admin Executive will be responsible for the smooth day\-to\-day administration and operational functioning of GiftAbled Foundation’s centers and programs in Uttar Pradesh. The role involves facility management, procurement, vendor coordination, travel and logistics, inventory, documentation, staff support, and coordination with program teams.

The ideal candidate should be organized, proactive, comfortable working in field locations, and capable of independently handling multiple administrative and operational activities.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Center \& Facility Management**

* Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of the assigned center/office.
* Manage office infrastructure, furniture, equipment, electricity, internet, housekeeping, security, and maintenance.
* Coordinate repairs, servicing, and preventive maintenance.
* Maintain proper records of assets and facilities.
* Ensure cleanliness, safety, accessibility, and basic compliance at the center.

**2\. Procurement \& Vendor Management**

* Collect requirements from program and support teams.
* Obtain quotations and coordinate procurement as per organizational procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors for supplies, services, repairs, and maintenance.
* Maintain vendor records, quotations, purchase documents, invoices, and payment\-related documents.
* Track pending orders and ensure timely delivery of materials.

**3\. Inventory \& Asset Management**

* Maintain records of office supplies, equipment, furniture, and other organizational assets.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of inventory and assets.
* Maintain stock registers and issue/return records.
* Report damaged, missing, or obsolete assets to the reporting manager.
* Ensure proper tagging and documentation of organizational assets.

**4\. Travel \& Logistics**

* Coordinate travel, accommodation, local transportation, and logistics for staff and visitors.
* Support field visits, meetings, training programs, workshops, and organizational events.
* Coordinate guest house/hotel bookings and maintain related records.
* Support vehicle management, including servicing, fuel records, insurance, documentation, and logbooks.

**5\. Administrative Coordination**

* Maintain administrative files, registers, agreements, bills, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Program, and other departments for operational requirements.
* Support onboarding arrangements for new employees and interns, including workspace, equipment, ID cards, and other requirements.
* Coordinate routine office communications and follow\-ups.

**6\. Finance \& Documentation Support**

* Collect and verify vendor invoices and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for timely processing of approved bills and payments.
* Maintain records of advances, petty cash, expenses, and administrative purchases as applicable.
* Ensure all administrative expenses are supported by appropriate documentation.

**7\. Events \& Program Support**

* Provide operational support for training programs, community events, workshops, meetings, and awareness activities.
* Arrange venues, seating, equipment, refreshments, transportation, printing, and other logistics.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external service providers to ensure smooth execution.

**8\. Compliance \& Safety**

* Ensure basic administrative and safety procedures are followed at the center.
* Maintain records related to licenses, AMC/service agreements, insurance, fire safety, equipment servicing, and other operational requirements.
* Escalate safety, security, infrastructure, or compliance issues promptly.

**9\. Field \& Center Coordination**

* Coordinate regularly with UP centers and field teams regarding operational requirements.
* Conduct periodic visits to centers to assess administrative and facility requirements.
* Follow up on pending operational issues and ensure timely closure.
* Support the State/Program Lead in implementing operational systems and processes.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate degree in **Business Administration, Management, Operations, Commerce, or a related field**.
* **2–4 years of experience** in administration, operations, facility management, procurement, logistics, or a similar role.
* Experience working with NGOs, social\-sector organizations, education/healthcare institutions, or multi\-location organizations will be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel, Word, Google Workspace, and basic documentation systems**.
* Fluency in **Hindi and English**.
* Willingness to travel between centers and field locations in Uttar Pradesh.

Key Skills

* Administration \& Operations Management
* Procurement \& Vendor Coordination
* Inventory \& Asset Management
* Travel \& Logistics Management
* Facility Management
* Documentation \& Record Keeping
* Basic Budget \& Expense Tracking
* MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Communication \& Coordination
* Problem\-solving and follow\-up
* Ability to work independently in field locations

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Practical, proactive, and solution\-oriented approach.
* Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable coordinating with vendors, employees, field teams, and external stakeholders.
* Willing to travel to **Balrampur, Siddharthnagar, Bhinga, and other UP locations** as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of administrative and operational requirements.

title: Business HR Associate
description:
**Business HR Associate**

**Department:** Human Resources (Business HR)  
**Designation:** Business HR Associate  
**Reporting To:** Head HR/ Senior Manager – HR / Business Head  
**Location:** Odisha

**Role Summary**

The Business HR Associate will function as a strategic HR business partner responsible for **recruiting, managing, monitoring and driving the productivity of a business team of approximately 20 employees**, including Counsellors, PREs, Marketing Executives and Marketing Interns. The role is highly performance\-oriented and requires continuous field and operational monitoring, employee productivity management, admission and revenue support, and execution of day\-to\-day HR operations.

The position demands **high dedication, strong leadership, discipline, accountability and the ability to work closely with Zonal Heads and business teams** to ensure that employees achieve their assigned targets and contribute directly towards organisational growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Team Management \& Productivity**

* Manage and supervise a team of approximately **20 employees**.
* Ensure daily attendance, discipline, punctuality and work accountability of all mapped employees.
* Monitor employee productivity on an **hourly basis** and maintain real\-time performance tracking.
* Conduct continuous follow\-ups with team members to ensure achievement of daily and weekly targets.
* Identify non\-performing employees and implement corrective actions, counselling and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Ensure strict adherence to reporting timelines and operational discipline.

**2\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning**

* Recruit Counsellors, PREs, Marketing Executives, Marketing Interns and other business support staff as per manpower requirements.
* Conduct sourcing, screening, interviews, coordination and onboarding of new employees.
* Maintain a continuous talent pipeline to support business expansion across all verticals.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies and workforce availability.

**3\. Business HR \& Revenue Generation**

* Work closely with the assigned **Zonal Head** and business team to drive admissions and revenue generation.
* Monitor lead generation, field activities, counselling productivity and admission conversions.
* Ensure that the assigned team contributes effectively towards business targets.
* Track team\-wise revenue performance and submit business productivity reports to management.
* Support admission campaigns, marketing drives and institutional growth initiatives across **KTGS, KTHS, IIG Academy, TITE, IIG Sports and IIG Arts Academy**.

**4\. Continuous Monitoring \& Reporting**

* Conduct continuous field and campus monitoring of assigned employees.
* Maintain **hourly reporting** of employee movement, productivity, bookings, admissions and target achievement.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly productivity reports.
* Escalate performance deviations and operational issues immediately to the Reporting Manager.
* Ensure accurate documentation of employee performance and business outcomes.

**5\. HR Operations**

* Manage employee attendance, leave records and daily HR coordination.
* Support onboarding, documentation, employee records and HRMS\-related activities.
* Coordinate performance reviews, KRA/KPI implementation and employee evaluation processes.
* Assist in employee engagement, grievance handling and policy communication.
* Ensure compliance with organisational policies and operational procedures.

**6\. Coordination \& Business Support**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for the assigned Zonal Head and business team.
* Coordinate with Finance, Administration, Operations and Marketing departments for smooth execution of business activities.
* Support fee collection follow\-ups, admission drives and business expansion initiatives wherever required.
* Participate in daily business review meetings and management discussions.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Recruitment closure of assigned positions within defined timelines.
* Productivity of the assigned 20\-member team.
* Admission and revenue contribution of the mapped business team.
* Employee attendance, discipline and reporting compliance.
* Hourly and daily monitoring accuracy.
* Reduction in non\-performing employees.
* Timely submission of productivity and business reports.
* KRA/KPI implementation and performance improvement of assigned employees.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management ability.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Recruitment and interviewing skills.
* Employee productivity and performance management expertise.
* Analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet aggressive business targets.
* High level of discipline, dedication and accountability.
* Strong follow\-up and monitoring skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS and reporting tools.

**Qualification**

* MBA / PGDM in HR, Marketing or Business Administration (preferred).
* Graduate with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* **1–2 years of experience** in HR, Business HR, Recruitment, Operations or Sales Team Management.
* Experience in **managing field teams, admissions, marketing teams or revenue\-driven operations** will be preferred.

**Working Conditions**

* **Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM (or as per business requirements).
* **Nature of Work:** Office \+ Field Monitoring.
* **This role requires** travel across all IIG Group offices, campuses and operational locations **Odisha.**

**Compensation**

* Salary: Rs 12,000/\-\-18,000/\-
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* Career progression into **Business HR Manager / HR Business Partner** roles.

**Declaration**

This role requires a **highly committed, target\-oriented and business\-focused HR professional** who can independently manage people, improve productivity, monitor operations continuously and directly contribute towards the organisation's admission and revenue growth.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

HR Services Department India, Chennai, India
   

  

 Our Graduate Programme in Chennai, India offers a unique opportunity to begin your professional journey while gaining practical experience in a collaborative and fast\-paced HR environment. If you've just completed your degree and are eager to develop your skills and build a strong foundation for your career, our Graduate Programme is the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

 We offer our graduates rewarding career opportunities within our HR Services team, where they can learn, grow, and contribute to a performance\-driven culture. The Graduate Programme provides graduates with the opportunity to gain exposure to key HR processes and support functions, helping them build a solid understanding of HR operations and shared services.
   

  

 Working alongside experienced professionals, graduates will develop practical skills while taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to day\-to\-day HR operations. Additionally, participants will have access to training programmes covering essential HR processes, business communication, professional etiquette, collaboration, and other core workplace skills.
   

  

 All graduates will be assigned mentors who will guide them throughout their development journey at Glencore. The mentoring programme will help new joiners understand our company culture, develop professionally, and build relationships across the HR Services team.
   

  

**Global HR Hub \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme**
 We are seeking a detail\-orientated, proactive, and highly motivated Graduate to be part of the Global HR Services team in Chennai, India, through the HR Hub which supports key operational processes for multiple Glencore offices worldwide.
   

  

 Global HR \& Payroll Services Graduate Programme is designed to prove your aptitude and test your resilience providing functional support to HR Services and Payroll, with opportunities to rotate between.
   

  

 The HR graduate will work in a shared service centre environment (our HR Hub) and the required attributes include strong organizational skills, a customer\-focused mindset, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, globally matrixed environment and gain exposure to international HR operations and best practice and contribute to impactful employee experiences across the globe.
   

  

 We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in or have recently graduated with a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related study is beneficial.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Purchase Manager** to manage procurement activities for our interior and turnkey projects. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **project procurement, BOQ, rate analysis, vendor management, material planning, cost control and negotiations**.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the timely availability of quality materials at the best possible prices while maintaining strict control over project\-wise purchase costs, wastage and documentation.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project Material Procurement

* Receive and review material requisitions from the Project/Site Team.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials to project sites.
* Coordinate closely with Project Managers and site teams to understand material requirements and timelines.
* Manage procurement requirements for multiple projects simultaneously.

2\. Vendor Management \& Negotiation

* Identify and develop reliable vendors, suppliers and manufacturers.
* Negotiate the best possible prices, discounts, payment terms and delivery schedules.
* Visit manufacturers and vendor locations as required for material selection, quality verification and commercial negotiations.
* Continuously develop new vendor sources to improve pricing and quality.

3\. BOQ \& Purchase Planning

* Study the **BOQ of every new project** in detail.
* Identify all materials falling under the company's purchase scope.
* Prepare and implement project\-wise purchase plans in coordination with the Project Manager.
* Research new or specialized materials in advance to ensure timely procurement at competitive prices.
* Monitor long\-lead items and ensure advance purchasing wherever required.

4\. Rate Analysis \& Cost Control

* Conduct detailed **rate analysis** for materials and compare market/vendor rates.
* Maintain item\-wise cost benchmarks and monitor material cut\-off costs.
* Negotiate continuously to reduce procurement costs without compromising quality.
* Highlight significant cost variations to management and Project Managers.
* Conduct regular market research to identify better pricing, quality and alternate sources.

title: Production Manager - Garment Unit
description:
Production Manager – Garment Unit

To manage and control the overall garment production operations of the unit and ensure achievement of **production targets, quality standards, productivity, efficiency, manpower utilization, cost objectives and on\-time delivery**.

The Production Manager is responsible for effective production planning and execution, line balancing, manpower deployment, capacity utilization, production performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities A. Production Planning \& Execution

* Ensure daily, weekly and monthly production targets are achieved as per the production plan.
* Convert the production plan into effective line\-wise and operation\-wise execution plans.
* Monitor production against planned quantities and take immediate corrective action for shortfalls.
* Ensure smooth flow of materials from cutting to sewing, finishing, packing and dispatch.
* Coordinate with PPC, IE, Cutting, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Finishing departments.
* Ensure production priorities are followed according to shipment requirements.
* Monitor WIP at different stages and avoid excess accumulation or line starvation.

B. Line Management \& Capacity Utilization

* Plan and allocate styles/orders to appropriate production lines based on capacity and skill requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilization of sewing lines, machines, manpower and working hours.
* Review line loading and capacity on a daily basis.
* Ensure effective line balancing to achieve required output and efficiency.
* Identify bottleneck operations and take corrective action.
* Ensure smooth style changeover and minimize changeover losses.
* Improve line productivity through effective manpower and machine utilization.

C. Manpower Management

* Ensure optimum deployment of tailors, helpers, checkers, supervisors and other production manpower.
* Monitor daily manpower availability, absenteeism and manpower productivity.
* Work with HR and Training Centre to address manpower shortages.
* Identify skill gaps and arrange appropriate training/retraining.
* Ensure newly trained operators are deployed based on skill level and production requirements.
* Develop and retain competent line supervisors and senior operators.
* Maintain appropriate **Tailor : Non\-Tailor ratio** and continuously improve manpower productivity.

D. Productivity \& Efficiency

* Achieve targeted line efficiency and productivity.
* Monitor hourly production and identify deviations from targets.
* Review operator\-wise and line\-wise productivity.
* Improve machine utilization and reduce idle time.
* Drive productivity improvement initiatives through line balancing, method improvement and operator skill enhancement.
* Work closely with Industrial Engineering to implement SAM/SMV\-based productivity improvements.
* Monitor and reduce production losses, downtime and non\-value\-added activities.

E. Quality Control

* Ensure production is carried out in accordance with approved quality standards and specifications.
* Coordinate closely with Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Ensure quality issues are identified and corrected at source.
* Minimize DHU, rework, rejection and alteration.
* Ensure operators follow approved methods and quality checkpoints.
* Take corrective action for recurring quality problems.
* Ensure first\-piece approval and style\-wise quality requirements are followed.

F. Delivery \& Shipment

* Ensure production is completed according to the committed shipment schedule.
* Closely monitor critical orders and production status.
* Escalate potential delivery risks immediately to Unit Head/PPC/Management.
* Prioritize production based on shipment urgency and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with finishing and packing teams to ensure timely order completion.

G. Production Performance Monitoring

* Review daily production reports and production KPIs.
* Monitor:
* Planned vs. actual production
* Line efficiency
* Productivity
* DHU/rework
* Absenteeism
* Manpower utilization
* Machine utilization
* WIP
* Rejection
* Downtime
* Changeover time
* On\-time production/delivery
* Conduct daily production review meetings with Line Supervisors and relevant departments.
* Analyse production losses and implement corrective actions.

H. Cost Control

* Control production\-related manpower and operational costs.
* Minimize overtime, rework, rejection, excess manpower and idle time.
* Improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Monitor consumption of production resources and reduce unnecessary wastage.
* Support management in achieving cost\-per\-garment targets.

I. Coordination with Other Departments

Maintain effective coordination with:

* **PPC** – Production planning and order priorities
* **Industrial Engineering** – Capacity, SMV, line balancing and productivity
* **Quality** – Quality standards, DHU, defects and corrective actions
* **Cutting** – Input availability and cutting plan
* **Finishing \& Packing** – Output flow and shipment readiness
* **Maintenance** – Machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance
* **Stores** – Material availability
* **HR** – Manpower planning, attendance, discipline and recruitment
* **Training Centre** – Skill development and operator conversion
* **Commercial/Merchandising** – Order and shipment requirements

Daily Responsibilities

* Review previous day's production performance.
* Review today's production plan and line loading.
* Check manpower availability and absenteeism.
* Review line\-wise targets and hourly production.
* Identify bottlenecks and take immediate action.
* Monitor quality and rework issues.
* Monitor machine breakdowns and downtime.
* Review WIP and material availability.
* Conduct production review with supervisors.
* Ensure critical orders receive appropriate priority.
* Report production status and major issues to Unit Head/DUH.

Weekly / Monthly Responsibilities

* Review production achievement against monthly plan.
* Analyse line\-wise efficiency and productivity.
* Review manpower requirement and deployment.
* Review absenteeism and manpower productivity.
* Analyse quality losses and rework.
* Review machine utilization and downtime.
* Identify productivity improvement opportunities.
* Prepare action plans for underperforming lines.
* Review performance of Production Supervisors and Line Supervisors.
* Support manpower and capacity planning for upcoming orders.
* Participate in monthly business and production review meetings.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Production Manager should be measured on:

* **Production Plan Achievement – %**
* **Line Efficiency – %**
* **Labour Productivity**
* **Output per Tailor / Operator**
* **DHU / Defect Rate**
* **Rework \& Alteration %**
* **Rejection %**
* **On\-Time Production / Shipment Achievement**
* **Manpower Utilization – %**
* **Absenteeism – %**
* **Machine Utilization – %**
* **Downtime – %**
* **WIP Level**
* **Overtime Control**
* **Cost per Garment**
* **Style Changeover Time**
* **Production Loss / Idle Time**

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Garment Technology, Textile Technology, Apparel Production, Industrial Engineering or related discipline.
* Relevant certification in garment production/operations will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **8–12 years of relevant experience** in garment manufacturing.
* Minimum **3–5 years in a supervisory/managerial production role**.
* Experience in handling multiple sewing lines and large production teams preferred.
* Strong experience in woven/knit garment manufacturing, depending on the unit's product profile.

BookMyBeats is an event ticketing and management platform built to help event organizers sell tickets, manage attendees, track sales and simplify event operations.

We are currently expanding our organizer network across Ahmedabad and Gujarat, especially in the events, Navratri, Garba, concerts, parties, college events and entertainment space.

* Good communication skills in English and Hindi/Gujarati.

* Confident, energetic and self\-motivated.

* Client communication and negotiation.
* CRM and sales pipeline management.
* Event industry operations.
* Ticketing and event management technology.

* New leads generated
* Organizers contacted

* Get hands\-on experience in the event\-tech industry.
* Work on real customers and real events.

* Build a professional network within the event industry.

title: Warehouse Assistant
description:
**Job Description**

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the warehouse by ensuring the **accurate receipt, storage, identification, handling, picking, packing and dispatch of materials and products**.

The role requires maintaining proper inventory records, ensuring warehouse cleanliness and safety, supporting stock verification activities, and coordinating with the Warehouse, Purchase, Sales, Accounts and Logistics teams to ensure smooth material movement.

The ideal candidate should be **physically fit, organized, responsible, detail\-oriented and willing to work in a fast\-paced warehouse environment**.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Receiving \& Unloading**

* Receive materials, products and equipment delivered to the warehouse.
* Assist in unloading and safely moving materials to designated storage areas.
* Verify received quantities against invoices, delivery challans, purchase orders or other relevant documents.
* Check materials for visible damage, shortages or discrepancies.
* Immediately report damaged, missing or incorrect materials to the Warehouse Supervisor.
* Ensure received materials are properly identified and tagged before storage.

**B. Storage \& Material Handling**

* Arrange materials systematically in their designated locations.
* Follow the warehouse's storage and stacking procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of materials.
* Maintain proper segregation of different product categories and materials.
* Handle products carefully to prevent damage, breakage or loss.
* Follow appropriate FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable.
* Ensure aisles, emergency exits and movement areas remain clear.

**C. Picking \& Packing**

* Pick materials accurately against approved material requisitions, sales orders or dispatch instructions.
* Verify product codes, descriptions and quantities before dispatch.
* Pack materials securely according to their nature and handling requirements.
* Assist in preparing materials for delivery or dispatch.
* Ensure the correct materials are handed over to the logistics/delivery team.
* Support loading activities while following safe material\-handling practices.

**D. Inventory Management**

* Assist in maintaining accurate physical stock.
* Update stock movement records as instructed.
* Conduct regular physical stock counting.
* Support monthly, periodic and annual stock verification.
* Identify and report stock shortages, excess stock, damaged goods or discrepancies.
* Assist in investigating differences between physical stock and system records.
* Maintain proper documentation for inward and outward movements.

**E. Warehouse Documentation**

* Maintain inward and outward material records.
* Assist with maintaining Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), delivery challans, stock transfer records and other warehouse documents.
* Ensure documents are properly filed and readily available when required.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments regarding pending documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of material movement.

**F. Warehouse Cleanliness \& Organization**

* Maintain cleanliness and proper housekeeping within the warehouse.
* Ensure materials are stored in an organized and accessible manner.
* Follow 5S principles and maintain workplace discipline.
* Remove unnecessary packaging materials and waste from operational areas.
* Ensure products are protected from moisture, dust, heat and other potential sources of damage, wherever applicable.

**G. Safety \& Compliance**

* Follow all warehouse safety procedures and company policies.
* Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
* Follow safe lifting and material\-handling practices.
* Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment or potential hazards immediately.
* Ensure fire exits, emergency equipment and access routes remain unobstructed.
* Follow company procedures for handling electrical, electronic, energy\-related or other specialized products, wherever applicable.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the warehouse.

**H. Internal Coordination**

Coordinate effectively with:

* Warehouse Supervisor / Manager
* Purchase Department
* Sales Department
* Accounts Department
* Logistics / Delivery Team
* Service / Operations Team
* Other departments as required

**3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

**Inventory Accuracy**

Maintain high accuracy between physical and recorded stock

**Picking Accuracy**

Ensure correct product, quantity and specification during picking

**Receiving Accuracy**

Verify incoming materials accurately against documents

**Dispatch Accuracy**

Ensure materials dispatched match approved requirements

**Stock Verification**

Complete assigned stock counts accurately and on time

**Material Handling**

Minimize product damage, loss and mishandling

**Warehouse Organization**

Maintain proper storage, labeling and housekeeping

**Documentation**

Maintain accurate and timely warehouse records

**Safety Compliance**

Follow all applicable warehouse safety procedures

**Timeliness**

Complete assigned warehouse activities within required timelines

**4\. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONMinimum Qualification**

* SSLC / Plus Two / ITI / Diploma or equivalent/ Graduation in any discipline
* Candidates with relevant warehouse experience will be preferred.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Diploma/ITI in Logistics, Supply Chain, Electrical, Mechanical or a related field.
* Certification in warehouse, inventory or logistics operations will be an advantage.

**5\. EXPERIENCE**

**Required Experience:** 0–1 years

Freshers with a positive attitude and willingness to learn may be considered.

Candidates with experience in:

* Warehouse operations
* Inventory management
* Logistics
* Distribution
* Electronics / electrical products
* Solar / energy products
* Consumer durables
* FMCG / retail distribution

will be an added advantage.

**6\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIESFunctional Skills**

* Basic knowledge of warehouse operations
* Basic inventory management knowledge
* Material handling
* Stock counting and verification
* Picking and packing
* Basic documentation
* Basic computer knowledge
* Ability to read and understand product codes and quantities

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Attention to detail
* Accountability
* Physical fitness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time management
* Reliability
* Willingness to learn
* Ability to follow instructions
* Problem\-solving ability
* Good communication skills
* Positive work attitude

**7\. COMPUTER SKILLS**

The candidate should have basic knowledge of:

* MS Excel
* MS Word
* Email communication
* Basic inventory/ERP software

Experience with warehouse management software, ERP systems or inventory applications will be an advantage.

**8\. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES – DAILY ACTIVITIES**

The Warehouse Assistant may be expected to:

**Start of Day**

* Check warehouse readiness and housekeeping.
* Review pending inward/outward activities.
* Coordinate with the Warehouse Supervisor regarding daily priorities.

**During Operations**

* Receive and verify incoming materials.
* Arrange and label stock.
* Pick materials against approved requirements.
* Pack and prepare materials for dispatch.
* Update relevant records.
* Support stock counting.
* Coordinate with logistics/delivery personnel.

**End of Day**

* Verify pending material movements.
* Ensure materials are properly stored.
* Maintain warehouse cleanliness.
* Secure warehouse areas and materials.
* Report discrepancies or pending activities to the supervisor.

**9\. PHYSICAL \& WORKING REQUIREMENTS**

The position involves an active warehouse environment and may require:

* Standing and walking for extended periods.
* Handling and moving materials.
* Lifting materials within safe and permitted limits.
* Working in indoor and warehouse environments.
* Occasional support during loading and unloading activities.
* Following safety procedures while handling materials.

**Note:** Manual handling should always be performed within applicable safety procedures and the individual's safe lifting capacity.

**10\. REPORTING \& COORDINATIONReports To**

**Warehouse Supervisor / Warehouse Manager**

**Internal Coordination**

* Purchase
* Sales
* Accounts
* Logistics
* Service
* Operations
* Administration

**External Coordination**

* Transporters
* Delivery personnel
* Suppliers/vendors, when assigned
* Customers/authorized representatives, when required

**11\. AUTHORITY \& RESPONSIBILITY**

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for:

* Safeguarding materials under their assigned responsibility.
* Reporting stock discrepancies immediately.
* Reporting damaged materials immediately.
* Following authorized material movement procedures.
* Maintaining confidentiality of warehouse and company information.
* Not releasing materials without proper authorization/documentation.
* Following company policies, procedures and safety requirements.

**12\. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are looking for a candidate who is:

**Reliable \| Physically Active \| Organized \| Responsible \| Detail\-Oriented \| Team\-Oriented \| Safety\-Conscious**

The candidate should demonstrate a willingness to take ownership of assigned warehouse activities and maintain accuracy even during periods of high workload.

**13\. CAREER GROWTH**

A potential career progression for this role may be:

**Warehouse Assistant**↓**Senior Warehouse Assistant**↓**Warehouse Executive**↓**Warehouse Supervisor**↓**Warehouse Manager**

Career progression will depend on performance, experience, skill development and organizational requirements.

**14\. EMPLOYEE VALUE PROPOSITION**

At Aldous Glare Tech \& Energy, employees can expect:

* Professional and structured work environment
* Opportunities to learn warehouse and logistics operations
* Exposure to inventory and supply\-chain processes
* Performance\-based career development
* Team\-oriented working environment
* Opportunities for increased responsibility based on performance

**15\. APPLICATION DETAILS**

**Position:** Warehouse Assistant**Location:** Kurumassery, Kochi, Kerala

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** 0–1 Years

**Salary:** ₹18000**\-**20000 per month

**ABOUT ALDOUS GLARE TECH \& ENERGY**

Establishes in 1995, for the past 31 years, Aldous Glare Tech \& Energy **(AGTE)** has successfully stood the test of time, establishing itself as a brand synonymous with trust and quality. In the ever\-evolving landscape of technology, we operate with the primary goal of increasing accessibility and awareness of the latest tech gadgets and appliances. We create opportunities for our channel partners through aggressive market development and continuous improvements achieved through agility.

Aldous Glare Tech and Energy **(AGTE)** is a technology product distribution company headquartered in Cochin, with branches in Trivandrum, Thrissur, and Calicut. Aldous Glare is India's leading distributor for smartphones, Android TVs, Google TVs, Smart ACs, Washing machines, solar products, and cloud services.

title: Influencer Marketing Operation Executive

Lakyou Beauty is a growing beauty and personal care brand focused on creating high\-quality, trend\-driven makeup and beauty products for the modern Indian consumer.

We are looking for a **highly organized and detail\-oriented Influencer Marketing Operations Executive** to manage the backend and operational execution of our influencer marketing activities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **coordination, documentation, Excel/Google Sheets, shipping, invoices, follow\-ups and keeping campaigns organized**.

Role Overview

The Influencer Marketing Operations Executive will be responsible for ensuring that influencer campaigns run smoothly from an operational perspective.

The candidate will work closely with the **Influencer Marketing, Finance, Warehouse, Marketing and Logistics teams** to ensure products are dispatched on time, campaign documentation is accurate, invoices are properly maintained, and influencer deliverables and payments are tracked.

**This is primarily an execution and backend operations role, not a creative/content creation role.**

Key Responsibilities1\. Influencer Campaign Operations

* Maintain and update the influencer campaign database.
* Record influencer details, campaign status, product allocation, deliverables and payment information.
* Create and maintain campaign trackers in **Google Sheets / MS Excel**.
* Track every influencer from onboarding to campaign completion.
* Maintain records of:
* Influencer name
* Contact details
* Instagram/YouTube profile
* Product sent
* Shipment details
* Campaign type
* Deliverables
* Posting date
* Payment status
* Invoice status
* Campaign status

2\. Shiprocket \& Product Dispatch

* Handle day\-to\-day **Shiprocket operations** for influencer shipments.
* Create shipping orders for influencers.
* Enter and verify influencer shipping addresses.
* Select the appropriate product/SKU and shipment details.
* Generate shipping labels and AWBs.
* Coordinate with the warehouse/team for product dispatch.
* Track shipments and delivery status.
* Follow up on delayed, failed or returned shipments.
* Maintain a record of all influencer shipments.
* Coordinate re\-shipping wherever required.
* Ensure products reach influencers within the campaign timeline.

3\. Influencer Invoices \& Payment Coordination

* Collect invoices from influencers/creators.
* Verify invoice details before submitting them for payment.
* Maintain an **Influencer Invoice Tracker**.
* Check influencer name, PAN, bank details, invoice amount, invoice number and campaign details.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for payment processing.
* Track pending, submitted and paid invoices.
* Follow up internally on pending payments.
* Maintain proper documentation for every influencer payment.
* Match invoices with approved campaign commercials and deliverables.
* Flag discrepancies in invoice amounts or payment details.

4\. Campaign Documentation

* Maintain complete documentation for every influencer collaboration.
* Organize campaign briefs, approvals, invoices, shipping details and payment records.
* Maintain proper Google Drive folders and campaign files.
* Ensure all campaign\-related documents are updated and easily accessible.
* Maintain proper naming conventions and documentation standards.

5\. Influencer Follow\-Ups

* Follow up with influencers for:
* Address details
* Product requirements
* Content submissions
* Posting dates
* Invoice submission
* Bank details
* Pending deliverables
* Send reminders to influencers regarding pending campaign requirements.
* Escalate delayed deliverables to the Influencer Marketing Manager.

6\. Campaign Deliverable Tracking

* Maintain a daily tracker of influencer deliverables.
* Track whether content has been:
* Briefed
* Product delivered
* Content received
* Approved
* Posted
* Link/report submitted
* Maintain screenshots/links of published content where required.
* Ensure no influencer campaign is left pending without follow\-up.

7\. Reporting \& MIS

Prepare regular reports and trackers covering:

* Total influencers onboarded
* Products dispatched
* Products delivered
* Pending shipments
* Pending content
* Content published
* Pending invoices
* Payments processed
* Pending payments
* Campaign\-wise spending
* Influencer\-wise spending
* Product\-wise gifting
* Monthly campaign status

Provide daily/weekly updates to the Influencer Marketing Manager.

8\. Coordination With Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

**Influencer Marketing Team**  
For campaign requirements, influencer details and deliverables.

**Warehouse Team**  
For product availability, packing and dispatch.

**Finance Team**  
For invoices, payments and documentation.

**Marketing Team**  
For campaign timelines and reporting.

**Logistics Team**  
For shipment\-related issues and returns.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**
* Good understanding of basic formulas, filters, sorting and data management
* Experience using **Shiprocket or other shipping/logistics platforms**
* Good understanding of invoices and basic payment documentation
* Excellent follow\-up skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage multiple influencers and campaigns simultaneously
* Good organizational and time\-management skills
* Comfortable working with large spreadsheets and repetitive operational tasks
* Ability to identify errors in data, invoices and campaign information
* Good email and WhatsApp communication skills

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Influencer marketing
* Creator management
* D2C brands
* Beauty / cosmetics / skincare / fashion
* E\-commerce operations
* Marketing operations
* Campaign coordination
* Logistics operations
* Shiprocket
* Invoice management
* Finance coordination

Experience with **Tally, Zoho Books, Shopify, Google Drive and other e\-commerce tools** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly organized**
* Extremely detail\-oriented
* Good with numbers and documentation
* Comfortable doing backend operational work
* Strong at follow\-ups
* Responsible with deadlines
* Good at Excel/Google Sheets
* Quick at learning new software
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple teams
* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions
* Able to manage repetitive tasks without losing accuracy

Important:

**This role requires strong execution and operational discipline.**

The candidate should enjoy working with **trackers, spreadsheets, invoices, shipping portals, documentation and follow\-ups** rather than looking primarily for a creative/social\-media role.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Accuracy of influencer database
* Timely creation of Shiprocket shipments

* Accuracy of influencer addresses

* Accuracy of invoice documentation

Qualification

HR Executive / HR Manager

**Company:** IIT Planet  
**Industry:** Education / IIT\-JEE Preparation  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** \[Insert location]  
**Experience:** 2–5 years  
**Salary:** \[Insert salary range]

Job Summary

IIT Planet is looking for an experienced and hands\-on HR professional to independently manage the complete employee lifecycle. The role includes hiring teachers, sales executives, counsellors, and support staff, along with payroll, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, and separation processes.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment and Hiring

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for teachers, sales executives, counsellors, HR, administration, and other operational roles.
* Understand manpower requirements and prepare appropriate job descriptions.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, recruitment agencies, and local networks.
* Screen applications, conduct initial interviews, coordinate technical or demo rounds, and negotiate salaries.
* Verify candidate documents, references, qualifications, and employment history.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, employment contracts, and joining documents.
* Maintain recruitment reports and ensure vacancies are filled within agreed timelines.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for frequently hired positions.

Onboarding and Employee Records

* Conduct onboarding and induction for new employees.
* Collect and verify identity, education, banking, tax, and previous\-employment documents.
* Create and maintain accurate physical and digital employee records.
* Explain company policies, responsibilities, performance expectations, and workplace standards.
* Manage confirmation, transfer, promotion, salary revision, and employment\-status documentation.

Payroll and Attendance

* Manage monthly payroll processing from start to finish.
* Verify attendance, leave, late arrivals, incentives, commissions, deductions, advances, and unpaid leave.
* Coordinate salary calculations for teaching, sales, and support teams.
* Prepare and verify payroll statements and salary slips.
* Coordinate statutory deductions and compliance requirements, including PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS, bonus, and gratuity, wherever applicable.
* Resolve employee payroll and attendance queries promptly.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all compensation information.

HR Operations and Compliance

* Manage daily HR administration and ensure smooth implementation of HR policies.
* Develop and update policies relating to attendance, leave, conduct, performance, incentives, discipline, and separation.
* Maintain employee databases, leave records, attendance reports, payroll files, and statutory registers.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour and employment laws.
* Coordinate with management, finance, legal advisers, and external consultants when required.
* Prepare HR reports covering headcount, vacancies, attendance, attrition, payroll, and employee performance.

Performance and Employee Relations

* Establish measurable performance goals and KPIs for teachers, sales employees, counsellors, and support teams.
* Coordinate probation reviews, performance appraisals, promotions, salary revisions, and performance\-improvement plans.
* Monitor employee conduct, productivity, attendance, and workplace behaviour.
* Address employee complaints, conflicts, grievances, and disciplinary concerns fairly and confidentially.
* Support managers with coaching, feedback, warnings, and corrective\-action processes.
* Organize employee engagement, training, recognition, and retention initiatives.

Separation and Termination

* Manage resignations, notice periods, handovers, exit interviews, and employee clearance.
* Handle disciplinary action and termination processes professionally, consistently, and in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Conduct or coordinate fair investigations before recommending disciplinary action.
* Prepare warning letters, show\-cause notices, termination letters, relieving letters, and experience certificates.
* Coordinate full\-and\-final settlements, recovery of company property, access removal, and closure of employee records.
* Maintain complete and confidential documentation for every separation decision.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience managing recruitment, payroll, HR operations, and employee relations.
* Experience hiring teachers and sales professionals is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Indian payroll practices and employment compliance.
* Experience using job portals, HRMS, attendance systems, Excel, and Google Workspace.
* Strong interviewing, negotiation, documentation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential matters with maturity.
* Capable of working independently and coordinating directly with senior management.

Key Performance Indicators

* Time taken to fill open positions.
* Quality and retention of new hires.
* Payroll accuracy and on\-time salary processing.
* Accuracy of attendance and employee records.
* Employee turnover and absenteeism.
* Timely completion of appraisals and HR documentation.
* Compliance with company policies and applicable laws.

How to Apply

Send your updated résumé to **hr@iitplanet.com** with the subject line **“Application for HR Executive/Manager – IIT Planet.”**

==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

=======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.

title: IT Technician
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Technician to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support computer systems, network devices, CCTV systems, software, and other IT infrastructure. The candidate will provide technical assistance to users, resolve hardware and software issues, and ensure that all IT equipment operates securely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, servers, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi devices, and other IT equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, internet, and operating system problems.
* Provide technical support to users through phone, remote access, email, and on\-site visits.
* Install and configure Windows operating systems, drivers, antivirus software, office applications, and other business software.
* Configure and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VLAN, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and basic routing.
* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras, NVRs, DVRs, PoE switches, access\-control systems, and related surveillance equipment.
* Monitor network connectivity and coordinate with internet service providers for link\-related issues.
* Perform preventive maintenance of computers, network devices, UPS systems, and other IT equipment.
* Manage user accounts, passwords, permissions, shared folders, and system access.
* Maintain records of IT assets, equipment allocation, repairs, warranties, and software licences.
* Take regular backups and assist in restoring data when required.
* Follow cybersecurity practices, including antivirus updates, patch management, access control, and data protection.
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or vendors.
* Prepare technical reports, service records, network diagrams, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Support IT deployment and maintenance activities at multiple project or client locations.
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies and safety procedures.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma, ITI, BCA, B.Sc. IT, B.Tech, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, Windows operating systems, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, LAN, WAN, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and network cabling.
* Knowledge of CCTV, NVR, DVR, IP cameras, PoE, and surveillance systems will be preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, remote\-support tools, antivirus solutions, and backup systems.
* Ability to read technical manuals and follow installation procedures.

Required Skills

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of computer hardware and networking.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple service requests.
* Good communication and user\-support skills.
* Willingness to travel to different sites when required.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle urgent technical issues.
* Basic documentation and reporting skills.
* Attention to detail and a service\-oriented attitude.

Preferred Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, networking, CCTV, or field technical services.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge may also apply.
* Experience in multi\-site IT infrastructure, surveillance projects, or field support will be an advantage.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Work Location

Office and project sites, as required

Reporting To

Network Engineer, Project Manager

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Information
  
  

About Us
  
  

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.
  
  

​
  
  

Why Join ByteDance
  
  

Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life \- a mission we work towards every day.
  
  

​
  
  

As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
  
  

​
  
  

Diversity \& Inclusion
  
  

​
  
  

ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.
  
  

​
  
  

Trust \& Safety at ByteDance
  
  

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every\-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

ByteDance recognises that keeping our platform safe for the ByteDance communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence\-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person\-centred, innovative and integrated approach.
