title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**ABOUT PROFESSOR ACADEMY** 




 Professor Academy is a growing educational institution in Madurai committed to academic excellence and holistic learner development. We are strengthening our HR function with a senior leader who can drive performance, build systems, and champion our people strategy.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking an experienced, performance\-driven Head of HR to lead our Human Resources function. This is a key leadership role responsible for developing measurable performance standards, managing the employee lifecycle, strengthening HR policies, and ensuring compliant day\-to\-day HR operations.
 



  





 We are looking for a professional who actively uses AI tools to enhance HR efficiency, stays current with HR technology, and is serious about career growth.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




  





**Performance Management \& Appraisal** 




**• Design and implement the organisation's performance appraisal system** 




**• Develop role\-specific KPIs, KRAs, and measurable performance standards** 




**• Establish monthly, quarterly, half\-yearly, and annual performance review processes** 




**• Coordinate probation reviews, confirmations, salary revisions, promotions, and PIPs** 




**• Analyse individual, departmental, and organisational performance trends** 




**• Provide management with performance dashboards and recommendations** 




**• Train managers and employees on appraisal processes, goal\-setting, and feedback delivery** 




  





**Policy \& Compliance** 




**• Develop, review, and** 
 implement
 **HR policies, SOPs, and employee guidelines** 




**• Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws — PF, ESI, Gratuity, TDS, Shops \& Establishments Act** 




**• Maintain statutory registers, records, and compliance documentation** 




**• Conduct periodic HR audits and address identified gaps** 




  





**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle** 




**• Manage the complete employee lifecycle — onboarding to exit and full\-and\-final settlement** 




**• Handle payroll processing, salary computation, deductions, and statutory filings** 




**• Manage attendance, leave, and HRMS data with accuracy** 




**• Drive employee engagement initiatives and address employee relations matters** 




  





**AI, Technology \& Continuous Learning** 




**• Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, HR\-specific AI platforms) to streamline HR workflows** 




**• Use HRMS, ATS, and digital payroll platforms effectively** 




**• Apply HR analytics and dashboards to support evidence\-based people decisions** 




**• Actively follow HR trends, attend webinars and certifications, and bring best practices into the organisation** 




**• Demonstrate a growth mindset — take ownership of personal learning and upskilling** 




  





**ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA** 




**• Education: MBA in Human Resource Management — Mandatory** 




**• Experience: Minimum 5 years in core HR roles, including Manager or Head\-level experience** 




**• Sector: Education or Healthcare — Preferred. Exceptional candidates from any industry welcome.** 




**• Language: Tamil — Mandatory. English proficiency required.** 




**• Location: Madurai — On\-site (Tamil Nadu candidates or those willing to relocate preferred)** 




**• AI Proficiency: Practical experience using AI tools in day\-to\-day HR work — not optional** 




**• Career Orientation: Visible track record of upskilling, certifications, or professional growth** 




  





**A NOTE ON SECTOR EXPERIENCE** 




**Education sector experience is preferred due to the nature of faculty management and institutional HR. However, exceptional candidates from any industry are welcome if they demonstrate:** 




**• Leading HR teams and driving organisational transformation** 




**• Building strong HR systems, policies, and compliance frameworks** 




**• Driving end\-to\-end performance management and employee development** 




**• Recruiting and retaining high\-quality talent** 




**• Creating a values\-driven, people\-centric organisational culture** 




**• Leading change, technology adoption, and continuous improvement** 




  





**REQUIRED SKILLS** 




**• Strong leadership and team\-management abilities** 




**• Excellent analytical and performance\-assessment skills** 




**• Strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll, and Indian labour law** 




**• Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills** 




**• Technologically adept — comfortable adopting new HR tools, software, and AI platforms** 




**• Self\-motivated learner — takes initiative in staying current with HR trends** 




**• Growth\-oriented mindset — sets personal development goals and works towards them** 




  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 




**• Competitive compensation aligned to experience and sector benchmarks** 




**• Opportunity to own and build the HR function at a growing institution** 




**• Direct visibility with senior leadership and meaningful impact on culture** 




**• A workplace that values continuous learning, technology adoption, and innovation** 




**• On\-site role in Madurai with a collaborative, mission\-driven team** 




  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




**Send your updated CV with the subject line: "Application – Head of HR \| \[Your Name]"** 




  





**Professor Academy is an equal opportunity employer.**

title: Director of Human Resources - Signia by Hilton Jaipur
description:
**Job Description**
**Welcome to Signia Jaipur!**
 This is a rare opportunity to lead the launch of Signia Jaipur, the first Signia by Hilton hotel in Asia Pacific and a landmark addition to Hilton’s rapidly expanding luxury portfolio in India. The 293\-room hotel, including 2 restaurants and 2 bars will represent the regional debut of one of Hilton’s newest and most innovative luxury brands, offering a unique platform to shape the guest experience, culture, commercial strategy, and market positioning from the ground up.
   

  

**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive human resources strategy that supports the company's long\-term business objectives and culture. As a
 **Director of Human Resources** 
 , you’re not just leading the hotel’s HR function – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Lead HR strategy and operations: Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives, ensuring compliance with corporate HR policies and local regulations
* Drive talent acquisition and workforce planning: Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and workforce planning to attract and retain top talent while optimizing labor costs
* Develop and engage talent: Oversee training programs, performance evaluations, and succession planning to support career growth and leadership development
* Manage team member relations: Guide employee relations, conflict resolution, and labor contract compliance, including grievance handling and negotiations
* Oversee HR policies and compliance: Establish and enforce HR policies, ensuring adherence to employment laws, wage and benefit administration, and workplace safety regulations
* Support financial goals: Develop and manage the HR budget, ensuring efficient use of resources while supporting hotel operations
* Cultivate a high\-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs


**Qualifications**
 At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
   

  

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
   

  

**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**
* Proven Director of Human Resources experience in luxury / upper\-upscale hotels
* Strong experience in managing pre\-opening luxury hotels
* Extensive HR experience across key functions—recruitment, training, performance management, and employee relations.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Strong understanding of labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance standards.
* Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and transparent practices.
* Proven ability to lead HR teams and influence organizational culture.
* Familiarity with HRIS systems and other HR\-related software.
* Excellent interpersonal and strategic communication abilities.
* Able to adapt to a dynamic hotel environment and support operational needs.


**About Us**
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**
 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
   

  

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

 Plant HR Manager

 : Shree Mahavir Metalcraft Pvt. Ltd. (ASSA ABLOY Group Company)

 Jamnagar, Gujarat
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Functionally to Director \& Head of HR \- SAARC and Administratively to Director \& head of SMI
   

  

**Position Summary**
 ASSA ABLOY India is looking for a seasoned Plant HR Head for its manufacturing unit in Jamnagar. The incumbent will serve as a change agent — reinforcing company culture, championing right behaviours, and driving end\-to\-end talent management at the plant level.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Operations \& Compliance
* Ensure hygiene and full compliance of HR operations aligned with ASSA ABLOY group standards and local legislation
* Oversee accurate and timely payroll processing and all statutory compliance obligations
* Manage HR audits and maintain 100% compliance with global company policies
* Liaise with government bodies including factory inspectors, labour departments, and local authorities as required
* Oversee general administration — housekeeping, canteen operations, and plant security
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Ensure global standards across all stages of the employee lifecycle — talent acquisition, induction, performance management, learning \& development, and engagement
* Establish and maintain a strong shop floor presence to stay connected with ground realities
* Manage and mitigate employee grievances by building open communication channels across all levels
* Culture \& Engagement
* Drive cultural assimilation initiatives and foster a strong sense of belonging across the plant workforce
* Build trusted relationships with cross\-functional teams and all levels of employees
* Cascade and support HR\-related initiatives that promote a positive, high\-performance work environment
* Business Partnership \& Leadership Development
* Understand the business strategy and partner with stakeholders to drive and sustain optimum employee productivity
* Mentor and guide plant leadership to effectively manage performance and build a pipeline of future leaders
* Support the Plant Operations Head in driving Employee Health, Safety \& Environment initiatives
* MIS \& Reporting
* Maintain and report accurate HR MIS on a timely basis to relevant stakeholders


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong change management capabilities with proven ability to influence without direct authority
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with high responsiveness
* Self\-motivated, ownership\-driven, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision
* High standards of work ethics, professional integrity, and deadline discipline
* Strong command over MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, and HRMS platforms such as SAP / SuccessFactors.


**Educational \& Experience Requirements**
* Master’s degree in Human Resources / MBA – HR / Master of Social Work (MSW)
* Minimum 10 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a plant HR leadership role
* Prior experience in a matrix organisation with cross\-cultural stakeholder management


 Note: This job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities. Rather, it is intended only to describe the general nature of the job. Employee may be expected to perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.
   

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
 Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
   

  

 As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
   

  

 As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

description:

**EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full\-Time**
**LOCATION: In\-Office – Jaipur, India**
**SHIFT TIMINGS: 10\.30 am to 7\.30 pm IST (Monday \- Friday)**
 We are looking for an experienced HR Generalist Lead to own and operate all people\-related functions for our Jaipur office. You will be the face of HR locally — the go\-to person for everything from hiring the next great engineer to making sure someone's first day feels like home. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, talent management,and facilities management services.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
**Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment**
* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for the Jaipur office across Engineering, Product, Sales, and


**Operations roles**
* Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling JDs, and build structured interview processes
* Build and manage a strong talent pipeline through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, college partnerships, and startup communities
* Conduct initial screening interviews and coordinate the full interview loop — scheduling, feedback collection, and debrief facilitation
* Negotiate and extend offers; manage the candidate experience from first touchpoint to Day 1
* Track and report on key recruiting metrics: time\-to\-fill, offer\-to\-acceptance rate, source quality, and pipeline health
* Proactively build talent pools for high\-frequency roles to reduce reactive hiring cycles


**Onboarding \& New Hire Experience**
* Design and continuously improve a world\-class onboarding experience for every new hire in Jaipur
* Run structured Day 1–5 orientation programs covering company culture, tools, team introductions, and role clarity
* Coordinate with IT, Finance, and team managers to ensure access, equipment, and a ready workspace before Day 1
* Manage onboarding documentation: offer letters, NDAs, compliance forms, and benefits enrollment
* Assign onboarding buddies and ensure 30/60/90\-day check\-in cadences are in place for every new hire
* Collect and act on onboarding feedback to continuously raise the bar on the new hire experience


**Offboarding \& Exit Management**
* Manage the full offboarding lifecycle with care and professionalism — from resignation to final settlement
* Conduct structured exit interviews and synthesize insights to share with leadership for retention improvements
* Coordinate with IT and Finance to ensure smooth access revocation, asset retrieval, and full\-and\-final processing
* Maintain compliance with applicable labor laws and ensure all exit documentation is complete and accurate
* Champion a positive exit experience that preserves the relationship and the company's employer brand


**Culture, Engagement \& Employee Experience**
* Act as the culture custodian for the Jaipur office — translate company values into day\-to\-day practices and rituals
* Design and run employee engagement initiatives: team events, recognition programs, town halls, and celebratory moments
* Run quarterly pulse surveys and eNPS; analyze results and drive actionable follow\-throughs with leadership
* Build psychological safety by being an approachable, trusted HR partner — someone people actually want to talk to
* Collaborate with the central People team (if applicable) to roll out company\-wide culture programs locally
* Champion diversity, inclusion, and belonging initiatives within the Jaipur office


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, HRIS data, and documentation for all Jaipur staff
* Oversee attendance, leave management, and payroll inputs in coordination with Finance
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws, statutory requirements (PF, ESIC, gratuity), and company policies
* Handle employee relations matters sensitively — grievances, performance conversations, and policy queries
* Continuously improve HR processes and documentation; build and maintain an accessible HR knowledge base


**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Must\-Haves:**
* 6\-7 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 1 year in a standalone or lead HR capacity
* Strong end\-to\-end recruitment experience — you have hired for technical and non\-technical roles independently
* Proven experience owning onboarding and offboarding programs, not just participating in them
* Excellent interpersonal skills — you build trust quickly and communicate with empathy and clarity
* Organized and detail\-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Working knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, and HR best practices
* Proficiency in HRIS tools, ATS platforms, and Google Workspace / Microsoft Office


**Great to Have:**
* Previous experience in a B2B SaaS, tech startup, or high\-growth product company
* Experience building or scaling an HR function from scratch in a new office or geography
* Familiarity with tools like Keka, Darwinbox, Greenhouse, Lever, or similar HRIS/ATS platforms
* Passion for employer branding and experience contributing to a company's external people narrative
* MBA in HR or a relevant professional certification

 at the National Land Agency.
   

  

**DIRECTOR, HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT \& DEVELOPMENT**
 This position reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

 To provide leadership for strategic human resource management in the Agency. The incumbent will be responsible for promoting best human resource practices and for monitoring internal and external signals pro\-actively to ensure that HR policies and practices have continual relevance to the business of the Agency.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities** 
 :**

* Provides leadership through adherence to professional conduct, setting objectives, working in team and monitoring

* Recommend, and execute the new strategic direction of the Human Resources Unit (HR) in accordance with the Agency’s new land titling mandate
* Assists the CEO in managing the HR issues as resulting from structural review they arise.
* Develops budget and Corporate Divisional Plan and ensures plan is implemented within budget
* Allocates human and financial resources to meet operational needs
* Monitors and evaluates operational results of the Division and effects corrective action where necessary
* Exercises prudent management over financial and physical resources
* Ensures all relevant information is communicated to the staff
* Ensures the conduct of performance reviews
* Participates in the selection of staff for the Agency
* Prepares and submits Divisional reports to the Chief Executive Officer
* Evaluates operational results against objectives and takes corrective action where necessary
* Ensures training and development needs are identified and steps taken to address them
* Prepares the Unit’s corporate and operational plans and budget
* Evaluates the Unit’s performance against operational objectives and takes corrective action where necessary
* Prepares and submits reports on activities of the Unit
* Provides assistance /advice to the Chief Executive Officer and Management Team on human resource matters
* Develops disciplinary and grievance procedures and ensures that they are implemented along established law and regulations

**Reports to** 
**:** 
 Chief People Officer
   

  

**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai, Hybrid
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable HR Manager to join our global People team. In this pivotal role, you will be the bridge between business strategy and people initiatives, providing expert guidance to senior leaders while shaping our India\-based people policies. You won't just be maintaining processes; you will act as a strategic advisor, driving the people agenda from onboarding through to organizational development. This is a unique opportunity to partner with key leaders, influence our culture, and leverage data to build a high\-performance environment. If you are passionate about developing people practices that align with business goals and thrive in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment, this role is for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities in this Role:**
* Strategic People Partnering: You will act as a consultant to our leadership team, translating business objectives into effective people strategies. You’ll guide leaders through organization design, change management, and leadership development, ensuring our teams are structured for long\-term success.
* HR Strategy \& Compliance: You will own the implementation of our India People strategy, ensuring our policies and practices are not only legally compliant with local regulations but also foster a positive, productive, and inclusive working environment.
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: You will maximize our HRIS and leverage people metrics—such as turnover and engagement—to provide actionable insights. You’ll identify trends, manage the HR budget, and make data\-backed recommendations that drive operational efficiency and employee well\-being.
* Employee Lifecycle Excellence: You will oversee the employee journey, from seamless onboarding and effective performance management to compensation and benefits programs. You’ll champion initiatives that improve productivity and retention, ensuring every team member is set up to thrive.
* Be the senior point of HR contact locally: You will support and guide our local people team specialising in employee relations, operations, talent acquisition and onboarding


**What Are We Looking For**
* HR/People Partnering Expertise: A strong background in HR and people partnering, with a deep understanding of India employment laws, policies, and practices. You are comfortable navigating complex regulatory landscapes while balancing business needs.
* Strategic Thinking \& Analytics: You have a proven ability to analyze data and translate it into actionable plans. You don't just solve immediate problems; you proactively develop strategies that align with our long\-term organizational goals.
* Stakeholder Influence \& Communication: You possess the confidence to coach and mentor senior leaders and employees alike globally. You are skilled at interpreting complex policies and communicating them clearly to diverse stakeholders, ensuring alignment across the business.
* Adaptability \& Independence: You are comfortable working autonomously in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You can manage multiple projects at once, thrive in ambiguity, and see a blocker as an opportunity to implement a better process.


**What Will Make You Thrive In Our Environment**
* Outcome\-Oriented: You are driven by results—measuring your success not just by policy implementation, but by the tangible impact on employee engagement, productivity, and retention.

* Resilience \& Curiosity: You are naturally inquisitive about how to improve processes and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. You remain composed and solution\-oriented when faced with shifting priorities.

title: Director of Human Resources
description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryana
 



 Shift: US shift timing, 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM
 



  





 Position Summary
 



  





 The Director of Human Resources is a senior leadership role responsible for the full scope of the HR function, including talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, learning and development, HR compliance, and organizational culture. Serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, the HR Director translates business objectives into people strategies that attract, develop, and retain top talent while ensuring the organization operates in full compliance with employment laws and best practices.
 



  





 This role is both strategic and hands\-on: the HR Director sets the long\-term people agenda while also leading day\-to\-day HR operations and mentoring the HR team.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Strategic HR Leadership
 



 Develop and execute a comprehensive HR strategy aligned with business goals and growth plans. Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and people\-related risks and opportunities. Build, lead, and mentor a high\-performing HR team; set clear priorities, KPIs, and development plans. Champion company culture, values, and employee engagement initiatives across all levels of the organization.
 



  





 Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 



 Own the end\-to\-end recruitment strategy, including employer branding, sourcing, selection, and onboarding. Partner with department leaders to forecast hiring needs and build succession pipelines for critical roles. Monitor recruiting metrics (time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, retention) and continuously improve hiring processes.
 



  





 Employee Relations \& Performance Management
 



 Oversee employee relations, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally sound handling of concerns, investigations, and disciplinary matters. Design and administer performance management programs, including goal setting, reviews, feedback, and improvement plans. Coach managers on leadership, communication, and conflict resolution to strengthen team effectiveness.
 



  





 Compensation, Benefits \& HR Operations
 



 Design and manage competitive compensation structures and benefits programs; conduct market benchmarking and annual reviews. Oversee payroll administration in partnership with finance, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Manage HRIS and people data; deliver reporting and analytics that inform executive decision\-making. Develop, maintain, and communicate HR policies, procedures, and the employee handbook.
 



  





 Compliance \& Risk Management
 



 Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations (e.g., FLSA, FMLA, ADA, EEO, OSHA). Maintain required records, filings, and postings; lead responses to audits, claims, and agency inquiries. Oversee workplace safety, leave administration, and workers' compensation programs. Deliver required training programs, including anti\-harassment, safety, and manager compliance training.
 



  





 Learning \& Development
 



 Build training and development programs that grow employee skills and leadership capability. Identify high\-potential talent and create career\-pathing and succession plans.
 



  





 HR Systems \& Foundational Projects (Key Deliverables)
 



 Build and implement an HRMS covering attendance and time tracking, payroll processing, and compliance management, including vendor evaluation, selection, configuration, data migration, and company\-wide rollout. Establish attendance and timekeeping policies and processes within the HRMS, with accurate reporting for payroll and management. Ensure the payroll and compliance modules support statutory requirements, filings, and audit\-ready record\-keeping. Develop, publish, and maintain a comprehensive Employee Handbook covering company policies, code of conduct, attendance and leave, compensation, benefits, and workplace standards; keep it current with changing laws and secure employee acknowledgments. Train managers and employees on the HRMS and handbook policies to drive adoption and consistent application.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



  





 Required
 



 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, including 3\+ years in an HR leadership role. Demonstrated experience across the full HR spectrum: talent acquisition, employee relations, compensation and benefits, performance management, and compliance. Strong working knowledge of employment law and regulatory requirements. Proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence at all levels, from frontline employees to executives. Excellent judgment, discretion, and integrity in handling sensitive and confidential matters. Strong communication, coaching, and conflict\-resolution skills. Proficiency with HRIS/HRMS platforms and people analytics; hands\-on experience implementing or migrating an HRMS (attendance, payroll, compliance modules) strongly preferred. Experience writing and maintaining employee handbooks and HR policy documentation.
 



  





 Preferred
 



 Master's degree in HR, Business, or related discipline. SHRM\-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent HR certification. Experience supporting both corporate and hourly/operations workforces. Experience leading HR through periods of rapid growth or organizational change.
 



  





 Key Competencies
 



 Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution. Leadership and team development. Business acumen and data\-driven decision\-making. Emotional intelligence and empathy. Adaptability and change management. Confidentiality and sound ethical judgment.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



 First 90 days: Full assessment of current HR practices, team, and compliance posture; HRMS requirements defined and vendor evaluation underway; Employee Handbook outline drafted.
 



 First 6 months: HRMS implemented for attendance, payroll, and compliance tracking; Employee Handbook published and acknowledged by all employees; core processes standardized.
 



 First year: HRMS fully adopted across the organization with reliable payroll and compliance reporting; measurable improvements in retention, time\-to\-fill, and manager capability.
 



  





 Equal Opportunity Statement
 



 We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

You will support operational processes across the full customer lifecycle—from pre\-sales through renewals and post\-sale validation—through data management, reporting, Salesforce administration support, and process improvement initiatives.

 Operations, Renewals \& Transaction Support

 At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door\-to\-door transport scheme, free food \& drinks, free game codes \& merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days \+ bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5\.

 Kwalee's Technology\- Data team is looking for a talented Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain Kwalee’s data infrastructure — pipelines, data lakes, and analytical data stores — that power game analytics, BI dashboards, and internal applications.
   

  

 The Data Engineer will work on large\-scale, high\-throughput event data and help the broader engineering and product teams move faster with reliable, high\-quality data.

* Contribute to data governance practices: data quality checks, schema management, lineage, and access controls.
* Review peers’ code and contribute to team standards around testing, CI/CD, and deployment via Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Work with stakeholders across the organisation to ensure scalability and performance as data volumes grow.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4\-5 years of professional data engineering experience.
* Advanced SQL: Complex transformations, performance tuning, analytical query design.
* Apache Spark: Hands\-on production experience with PySpark or Spark SQL; understanding of distributed execution, partitioning, and performance.
* Databricks: Building and operating pipelines on the Databricks platform (Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).

 You’re the kind of engineer who cares about the downstream consumer of your data as much as the pipeline itself. You write code that your colleagues can read and debug at 3 am. * Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch \& Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.


**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**
 At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

 ROLE DETAILS
   

  

 Level: L2 — Data Analyst

 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon.
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
 Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
   

  

 Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
   

  

 Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.
   

  

 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an L2 Data Analyst for our India\-based Applied AI team. This is an opportunity for someone who has demonstrated the ability to work with data, write code, and solve analytical problems — and is ready to deepen their expertise on the data science track. The ideal candidate has some background in statistics and machine learning techniques.
   

  

 Our team builds AI\-powered solutions across Arcadia's utility data platform, with a focus on utility bill acquisition, document processing, and data quality. In this role, you'll work alongside product managers and data scientists to support experimentation, data analysis, automation, and product development — gaining hands\-on exposure to ML/AI workflows while driving real impact through rigorous analytical work.
   

  

 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Contribute to the data layer for AI workflows — design, optimize, and maintain SQL queries in Snowflake to build sample datasets, power reporting, and support testing across our utility data platform.
   

  

 Write production\-quality Python — develop and maintain scripts for data transformation, pipeline automation, and validation, with an emphasis on code that's clean, scalable, and reproducible.
   

  

 Build the foundation for evaluation workflows — curate evaluation datasets, define performance metrics, and create repeatable benchmarking frameworks that help the team measure and compare model quality.
   

  

 Dig into the data before anyone else does — run exploratory analysis and data profiling to surface quality issues (missing values, duplicates, anomalies) and flag what matters for downstream work before it becomes a problem.
   

  

 Be the analytical right hand to Product Managers / Data Scientists — support model development, experimentation, root\-cause investigations, and ad hoc deep dives, picking up context quickly and delivering reliable answers.
   

  

 Make your work easy to build on — document analyses, methodologies, and findings clearly so they're reproducible, reviewable, and useful to the next person who picks them up.
   

  

 Get early exposure to ML/AI in production — support the development and evaluation of ML and AI\-powered data pipelines, learning how models move from prototype to product.
   

  

 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 2–3 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics, data science, statistics, or a related field.
   

  

 Strong Python programming skills, with experience developing clean, maintainable scripts for data processing, automation, and analysis.
   

  

 Strong SQL skills, with proficiency in joins, aggregations, window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), and query optimization.
   

  

 Experience working with large datasets and preparing high\-quality data for analysis through data cleaning, transformation, validation, standardization, and investigation of data quality issues such as missing values, duplicates, inconsistencies, and anomalies.
   

  

 Solid understanding of exploratory data analysis (EDA), descriptive statistics, and basic experimental design and evaluation.
   

  

 Curious, detail\-oriented approach to data — asks "why does this look wrong?" before assuming it's right.
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders through presentations, reports, visualizations, and well\-structured documentation.
   

  

 Ability to work independently on well\-defined tasks while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
   

  

 Demonstrated interest in machine learning, NLP, or Generative AI, with a willingness to learn and apply these technologies, is a plus.

title: Machine Learning Engineer — Computer Vision
description:
*Note to applicants: Instructions on how to submit your application via email are at the bottom of this post.* 




  





**About Lear Labs** 




  





 Lear Labs is an enterprise AI lab dedicated to solving the hardest AI and machine learning problems for leading organizations in India and beyond. We move past theoretical proofs\-of\-concept to build robust, production\-ready systems. Our partners include top\-tier enterprises, sprawling conglomerates, and government bodies who rely on us to deliver models that work reliably in the real world.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are building a production computer\-vision platform that ingests large volumes of continuous imagery and video captured from moving devices operating at variable speeds. It turns this data into structured, geo\-referenced findings, and serves those findings to non\-technical decision\-makers through dashboards and reports.
 



  





 This is not a research seat and it is not a proof\-of\-concept. The models you build will run continuously against real\-world footage — shot at speed, in bad light, on cheap lenses, across seasons — and the output will be used by people who make budget and operational decisions on it. Accuracy, reliability, and cost per processed hour of video all matter.
 



  





 You will be the technical owner of the vision and data side of the platform: model architecture, the training data pipeline, the labelling standard, the evaluation harness, and the GPU infrastructure it all runs on. As the platform grows, this role grows into an ML lead position with a team under it.
 



  





**What the Work Involves** 




  





**Detection models.** 
 Fine\-tuning object detection models on custom data — including classes that are small, low\-contrast, or partially occluded. Choosing thresholds against a real objective rather than a leaderboard metric.
 



  





**Tracking and counting.** 
 An object appearing across a hundred frames is one object, not a hundred. Tracking across occlusions and gaps, de\-duplication, and counts that hold up when someone checks them by hand.
 



  





**Training data.** 
 This is where most vision projects actually fail. Defining what gets labelled and how, running annotation quality checks, handling class imbalance and long\-tail cases, deciding what to label next, and keeping datasets versioned so any model can be traced back to what trained it.
 



  





**Video and imaging.** 
 Frame sampling from continuous video, and understanding how frame rate, resolution, exposure, motion blur, lens distortion, and compression affect what a model can and cannot see. Being able to say what a good capture looks like instead of accepting whatever arrives.
 



  





**Evaluation.** 
 A single mAP number is not an evaluation. Per\-class precision and recall at chosen thresholds, performance sliced across the conditions that vary in data, frozen test sets, and regression checks before anything ships.
 



  





**Data and infrastructure at scale.** 
 Terabytes of images and video with metadata attached to every frame. Storage layout, indexing, and pipelines that keep GPUs busy rather than waiting on I/O. Multi\-GPU training in the cloud, reproducible pipelines with experiment tracking, and inference that scales predictably.
 



  





**Your own environment.** 
 Linux, Docker, the CUDA and driver stack, and secure SSH access. When the driver stack breaks, it is yours to fix.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Must have — the fundamentals** 



* **Hands\-on computer vision work** 
 , including at least one system that reached real users and that you kept working on afterwards. Years matter less to us than what you have actually shipped.
* **Fine\-tuning object detection models on custom datasets** 
 — YOLO family or equivalent.
* **Solid PyTorch and CNN fundamentals.** 
 Comfortable reading and modifying a training loop, not only calling a wrapper library.
* **Judgement about data.** 
 You can look at a training set and say what is wrong with it, and you have fixed a data problem that was pretending to be a model problem.
* **Comfortable on Linux with Docker and cloud GPUs.** 
 You can set up your own training environment and keep it running.
* **Clear communication in English and Basic spoken in Hindi.** 
 You will write things down — guidelines, evaluation notes, what you found — and explain limitations honestly to people without an ML background. You raise problems early rather than late.
* **Projects.** 
 If you have participated in collegiate competitions—such as SAE (BAJA, Formula Student / FSAE), robotics challenges, or high\-stakes computer vision hackathons—or built hands\-on systems from scratch, make sure to highlight this upfront. We care deeply about real\-world engineering grit over theoretical research.



  





**Strong plus — but learnable here if the fundamentals are there** 



* Multi\-object tracking and re\-identification.
* Vision Transformers, and a view on when they are worth the compute and when they are not.
* Working with large datasets end to end: ingestion, cleaning, de\-duplication, sharding, versioning.
* Segmentation, or estimating size and extent rather than just drawing a box.
* Inference optimisation — ONNX, TensorRT, quantisation, deployment to edge or mobile hardware.
* Experiment tracking and MLOps tooling (Weights \& Biases, MLflow, DVC, or equivalent).
* Networking and access setup: bastion hosts, VPNs, firewall rules, key management.
* Model monitoring and drift detection in production.
* Self\-supervised or semi\-supervised pre\-training on unlabelled data.
* Prior work in domains where imagery is captured in uncontrolled outdoor conditions — infrastructure inspection, agritech, autonomous driving, industrial QC, drone or aerial imagery.



  





 You are not expected to have all of the second list. Two or three, plus the fundamentals, is a strong application.
 



  





**What you'll Get** 



* **Real ownership.** 
 Features, not tasks. Production systems, real users, actual stakes.
* **Direct founder access.** 
 Work closely with the CEO and CTO on architecture, product, and technical strategy.
* **Accelerated growth.** 
 Hard problems and a tight feedback loop — you will grow more in six months here than in two years most places.
* **Serious hardware.** 
 Access to powerful compute for machine learning work.
* **Depth ahead of you.** 
 The vision and ML work here is not a single build with an end date.
* **Compensation.** 
 Competitive and negotiated case\-by\-case. We evaluate compensation individually based on your depth of experience, technical capability, and what you bring to the table. We discuss expectations openly during the initial conversation.



  





**Location** 




 We are based in Bangalore. You will also travel to our sites in Bhopal for active fieldwork and working at our operations hub. We treat data collection as a first\-class engineering problem. You will travel to the field to see exactly how your footage is captured on the ground, because understanding the physical reality of the data pipeline is the only way to build models that actually survive in production.
 



  





**How To Apply** 




  





 We care about hands\-on experience. Send us:
 


1. **Your CV** 
 , and
2. **A GitHub repository or a short write\-up** 
 about a computer vision project you personally built. We are interested in the engineering reality, not the polish:


* What the task was and what the data looked like — volume, source, how it was collected and labelled.
* What you tried first that did not work.
* Your metrics before and after, and which operating point you chose and why.
* How it was deployed, what broke, and what you changed as a result.
* What the model still gets wrong.



  





 A small project explained honestly tells us more than a large one described vaguely. Applications without code or a project description will not be shortlisted.
 



  





**To apply:** 
 email himanshu@getlear.com.
 **Subject line:** 
 job title \+ your name.

 We are building an enterprise\-grade Agentic AI Platform capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, collaboration, memory, learning, and execution at scale. This platform will power procurement transformation for some of the world's largest organizations.
 



 We're looking for exceptional engineers and researchers who want to solve difficult AI systems problems—not just integrate APIs.
 



 If you enjoy reading research papers, building new algorithms, experimenting with frontier models, and turning research into production systems, we'd love to talk to you.
 



**What You'll Build**

* Autonomous AI Agents

 Work on problems such as:
 


* Agent planning

* Context engineering

* Memory management
* AI evaluation
* Autonomous decision\-making

 Design rigorous experiments to improve:
 


* Accuracy

* Agent success rates
* Cost efficiency
* Planning quality
* Benchmark performance



**Who We're Looking For** 




 We're far more interested in exceptional problem\-solving ability than years of experience with a specific framework.
 



 You might be a great fit if you have:
 


* M.Tech or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, Computational Linguistics, or a related discipline
* Outstanding software engineering skills in Python

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**Title : AI Agent Engineer \| Founding Team** 




 Location: Bengaluru / Hybrid
 



 Type: Full\-time \| Founding Team
 



  





**About DecisionX** 




 DecisionX is building the Decision Infrastructure for the enterprise \- a causal, self\-learning AI system that helps organizations move beyond search and retrieval to actual decision\-making. We're trusted by global enterprises across pharma, CPG, and manufacturing, powering 10,000\+ decisions a month. Ranked \#2 globally in enterprise reasoning on the Spider 2\.0 Lite benchmark and recognized by NVIDIA as an AI startup to watch \- we're a small, fast\-moving team solving one of the hardest unsolved problems in enterprise AI.
 



  





**Why this role exists ?** 




 We are live inside CPG \& Pharma field\-force workflows, and manufacturing RCA chains, and every one of those go\-lives needs an engineer at heart who can sit inside the customer's world.
 



  





**What you'll do ?** 



* Take a customer's raw mess: ERP exports, flat files, half\-documented spreadsheets, and turn it into a working worldview of their business.
* Join operational datasets across systems that were never meant to talk to each other
* Write and run the eval query bank for each customer's real questions, on their real data, and fix the agent when it's confidently wrong.
* Estimate LLM cost and latency for a customer's actual query volume before it becomes a support ticket.
* Sit in requirement calls with customers, and come out with a spec they sign off on.
* Own the pilot: timeline, data quality, agent accuracy, go\-live.
* Notice when three customers hit the same wall, and push the fix into the platform once.



  





**What you'll bring** 




  




* 1\-3 years as a software or AI/ML engineer. Founding engineer or early\-startup experience counts for more than the years.
* SQL fluency across joined, messy, multi\-table enterprise data. You've done this on data that wasn't clean and wasn't yours.
* Strong Python, and enough JS/TS to not be blocked on a frontend engineer.
* You've built with LLMs in a real product: prompting, RAG, tool\-calling, agent orchestration. Not just a weekend hackathon, a thing that ran in front of a user.
* You've written evals before, and you know the difference between an agent that sounds right and one that is right.
* You can hold a technical conversation with a customer's IT team without needing a product manager translating \[read: babysitting] for you.



  





**Even better** 



* You've priced or optimised LLM cost and latency for a live product.
* You've familiarity with Databricks, Snowflake, or SAP systems.
* You've been the second or third engineer somewhere, or founded something yourself or worked on passion projects on the sides.



  





 If your idea of a good week is a clean sprint with well\-scoped out tickets, this role will annoy you. If it's solving a customer's problem by Thursday because a real business decision is riding on it, apply.

title: POWER BI & CLOUD DATA ENGINEER
description:
**POWER BI \& CLOUD DATA ENGINEER** 




*Primary focus: Power BI analytics delivery \| Supporting capability: Databricks data engineering* 




**Experience : 7 to 11 Years** 




**Role emphasis** 




 This role is intended for a strong Power BI developer or analytics engineer who can also work effectively with Databricks, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and cloud data engineering patterns.
 



 At TE
 



 At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable, and more connected world.
 



 Job Overview
 



 This position is primarily responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise Power BI analytics solutions on TE's Databricks platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, product owners, data architects, analytics engineers, and governance teams to deliver intuitive dashboards, semantic models, governed reporting assets, and actionable insights that support business decisions.
 



 In addition to Power BI development, the role contributes to Databricks\-based data engineering activities, including data transformation, analytical data modeling, optimization of reporting datasets, and migration of legacy logic into scalable cloud\-based solutions. The position owns the end\-to\-end analytics lifecycle from requirements gathering and data modeling through dashboard development, deployment, performance optimization, governance, documentation, production support, and continuous improvement.
 



 What Your Background Should Look Like
 



 Responsibilities
 



 Power BI \& Analytics Delivery, Primary Responsibility
 



**Expected emphasis: approximately 60 to 70 percent of the role** 



* Design, develop, test, and deploy enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, semantic models, and reusable analytical solutions using Databricks as the primary data platform.
* Partner with business stakeholders and product owners to translate KPIs, reporting needs, and analytical questions into technical designs and delivery plans.
* Build scalable semantic models using star schemas, conformed dimensions, reusable measures, and clearly defined business logic.
* Develop advanced DAX measures, calculation groups, time\-intelligence logic, and Power Query transformations.
* Connect Power BI with Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables, governed views, and composite models.
* Evaluate and optimize data models, including star, snowflake, and flattened structures, for performance, usability, and scalability.
* Design intuitive report experiences including drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips, conditional formatting, mobile layouts, accessibility, and user\-friendly navigation.
* Tune report and semantic model performance using Power BI Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, VertiPaq Analyzer, aggregations, query diagnostics, and incremental refresh.
* Implement row\-level security, object\-level security, workspace security, app distribution, and governance controls.
* Publish and manage Power BI workspaces, semantic models, reports, apps, refresh schedules, gateways, and deployment pipelines.
* Develop paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder where required.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, regression testing, UAT support, troubleshooting, user enablement, and production support.
* Document report specifications, semantic model designs, KPI definitions, measure catalogs, data dictionaries, support guides, and reusable reporting standards.



 Databricks \& Cloud Data Engineering, Supporting Responsibility
 



**Expected emphasis: approximately 30 to 40 percent of the role** 



* Analyze existing data warehouse implementations and support migration, modernization, and consolidation efforts.
* Reverse\-engineer legacy PL/SQL and SQL logic, then translate business rules into scalable Spark SQL within Databricks notebooks.
* Design and develop AWS S3 and Delta Lake\-based analytical data solutions using Databricks.
* Build and maintain ETL and ELT data pipelines, ingestion frameworks, and transformation processes that support reporting and analytics needs.
* Collaborate with data architects to implement enterprise ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
* Collaborate with engineers to define gold\-layer datasets and ensure data quality, lineage, and business\-rule consistency.
* Support Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, Delta Lake table design, governed views, and cloud data warehouse design patterns.
* Tune Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, SQL Warehouses, pipelines, and table structures to improve performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Support CI/CD, Git, version control, release automation, DevOps practices, job scheduling, backup coordination, and production support.



 Collaboration, Delivery, and Governance
 


* Participate in Agile ceremonies, roadmap planning, architecture reviews, sprint activities, production readiness reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
* Work cross\-functionally with business stakeholders, product owners, data architects, analytics engineers, governance teams, and support teams.
* Mentor developers through design reviews, code reviews, reusable engineering standards, Power BI best practices, and documentation standards.
* Promote consistency across reporting solutions by aligning semantic models, measures, data definitions, security, and release practices.



  





 Skills, Experience, and Education
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of relevant experience across business intelligence, analytics delivery, and data engineering.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Power BI development experience, including dashboards, reports, semantic models, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Service, and enterprise deployment practices.
* 3\+ years of Databricks, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake experience supporting enterprise analytics and reporting solutions.
* Strong experience integrating Power BI with Databricks SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake tables, governed views, and cloud\-based data platforms.
* Expert knowledge of Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power BI Report Builder, DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, and BI performance optimization.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, including experience refactoring or migrating legacy warehouse logic into modern cloud analytics platforms.
* Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java, with practical experience supporting data transformation and automation needs.
* Strong experience with AWS S3, Databricks, Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, ETL and ELT, metadata management, and data warehouse design.
* Experience with Import mode, DirectQuery, composite models, query folding, incremental refresh, aggregations, and Power BI performance tuning.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, REST APIs, deployment pipelines, Agile methodologies, governance, testing, and production support.
* Strong stakeholder communication, requirements analysis, leadership, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Microsoft PL\-300 certification is strongly preferred. Databricks certification is preferred or a strong plus.



 Preferred Profile
 


* A senior Power BI developer, BI engineer, or analytics engineer who is comfortable working directly with business users and technical data teams.
* Strong ability to design business\-friendly reporting experiences while also understanding the Databricks data structures that support them.
* Practical experience balancing semantic model design, report usability, data quality, governance, and performance.
* Ability to move between business requirements, Power BI modeling, Databricks SQL, data validation, and production support without losing sight of the business outcome.

-

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Understanding of manufacturing processes and shop floor operations.
* Knowledge of nesting, fabrication, or CNC workflows.

 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Test Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Performance Validation
* Conduct throughput testing using tools such as iPerf, IxChariot, octoScope, Spirent, or IXIA.
* Validate performance across different Wi\-Fi standards (802\.11ac/ax/be).
* Measure PHY data rate, throughput, Packet loss, Jitter, Latency, retransmission rate
* RF \& OTA (Over\-the\-Air) Testing
* Perform RF validation including RvR, RSSI, SNR,Adjacent channel interference
* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.


**Required Skills \& Qualification**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation
* Wireless Protocols: Strong understanding of IEEE 802\.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), OFDM, MIMO, MU\-MIMO, QoS (WMM)
* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
* Automation framework development experience


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

description:
**Job Description: QA Engineer (Paid)** 




  





**About GoQuant** 




 GoQuant is a financial technology company dedicated to providing high\-performance trading solutions for digital assets. We empower professional traders and institutions with a comprehensive suite of tools, including an advanced Order Execution and Management System (OEMS), high\-quality Market Data services, and a robust Portfolio and Risk Management System (PMS/RMS). Our focus is on delivering lightning\-fast execution, ensuring private and secure trading environments, and offering sensible, fixed\-fee structures. By integrating with a wide array of venues including centralized and decentralized exchanges, prime brokers, and market makers, GoQuant enables clients to maximize their trading potential with clean, reliable data and cutting\-edge technology.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented QA Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our trading platforms and financial applications through comprehensive testing strategies and automation frameworks. You will work closely with development teams, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust testing solutions. Your primary focus will be on maintaining the highest standards of software quality while contributing to the full software development lifecycle from requirements analysis to production deployment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 \- Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis to implementation and maintenance.
 



 \- Translate complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications and comprehensive test implementation plans.
 



 \- Design and develop automated testing frameworks and tools using C\+\+, Python, and JavaScript for critical trading systems.
 



 \- Create and maintain comprehensive test suites for critical trading components, ensuring coverage of functional, performance, and edge\-case scenarios.
 



 \- Develop benchmarking tools for measuring system performance, latency, and throughput in high\-frequency trading environments.
 



 \- Contribute to architectural discussions and provide direct input in design decisions to ensure testability and quality from the ground up.
 



 \- Provide technical support for client implementations and troubleshooting complex production issues.
 



 \- Implement and maintain continuous integration/deployment pipelines with integrated testing automation.
 



 \- Build monitoring solutions for system performance, reliability, and quality metrics in production environments.
 



 \- Write production\-quality code for new testing features, tools, and quality improvements.
 



 \- Collaborate with development teams to optimize critical execution paths and identify performance bottlenecks.
 



 \- Create detailed technical documentation for testing procedures, frameworks, and quality standards for both internal and external use.
 



 \- Conduct thorough regression testing and validate system behavior across multiple trading venues and market conditions.
 



 \- Establish and promote quality assurance best practices, testing standards, and methodologies across the organization.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 \- Proven QA engineering experience with a strong background in testing complex, high\-performance financial or trading systems.

 \- Strong experience with automated testing frameworks and tools (e.g., pytest, Jest, Google Test, or similar).

 \- Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions.
 



 \- Knowledge of performance testing and benchmarking tools for low\-latency systems.
 



 \- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
 



 \- Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.
 



 \- Ability to design and implement comprehensive test strategies for complex distributed systems.
 



 \- Experience with API testing, database testing, and microservices testing.

 \- Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and document technical findings.

**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**

 \- Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
 



 \- Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and real\-time data processing.
 



 \- Experience with security testing and compliance requirements in financial services.
 



 \- Knowledge of database systems (PostgreSQL, Redis, InfluxDB) and data validation techniques.

title: Software Engineer – Infrastructure
description:
At Barclays, we do not just adapt to the future — we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as part of the Payment Screening Team, where you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the resilience, scalability, and reliability of critical payment screening systems. You will be a key contributor in driving the Infrastructure, DevOps, and CI/CD agenda for Payment Screening, with responsibility for demonstrating measurable improvements across key operational metrics.
   

  

 Working closely with the Infrastructure Lead, Engineering teams, and stakeholders across Payment Screening, you will help deliver high\-performing solutions through agile delivery models.
   

  

 You will contribute to the delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of secure and resilient infrastructure platforms for Payment Screening. This includes supporting cloud and container\-based environments, strengthening DevOps practices, maintaining effective risk and control standards, and helping ensure operational reliability throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

**To be successful as a Software Engineer – Infrastructure, you should have experience with:**
* Infrastructure design and implementation.
* Cloud automation and platform engineering.
* Cybersecurity best practices and secure infrastructure delivery.
* Technical debt management and continuous improvement.
* Linux, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Kubernetes and Docker.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms.
* Experience working with certificates and keys.


**Some Of Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Knowledge of encryption, firewalls, and access control.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible.
* Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP), routing, switching, and security.
* Basic database concepts.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent platforms.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant to success in the role, including risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology capabilities, and job\-specific technical expertise.
   

  

 The location of the role is Pune, India.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Job Description**
**IT System Engineer**
 We are seeking IT System Engineer. Role is to involve in coordination of hardware and software acquisition, tracking, assignment, decommissioning, disposal and generally maintaining hardware and software inventory and assets; coordinates asset movement throughout the company and maintains software title and license inventories.

* Support and resolve issues across both cloud and on\-prem environments.

 On Prem Infrastructure
   

  

* Support and maintain on\-prem infrastructure and related environments.

* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools.
* 1\+ years of experience with ticketing tools like ServiceNow.
* Basic understanding of security and compliance practices.
* Drive process improvement, SOP creation, and documentation governance.

* NSGs and UDRs
* Load Balancers
* Private Link and Private Endpoints
* DNS concepts
* VPN and ExpressRoute connectivity


**Security**

* Managed Identities
* Key Vault integration
* Logging and monitoring standards
* Security and compliance best practices

You will bridge the gap between development and operations by applying software engineering mindsets to containerized infrastructure challenges. This entry\-level role focuses on GitOps application deployments via ArgoCD, alert triage, Grafana Labs observability, and leveraging AIOps platforms, backed by strong OS and networking knowledge.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* GitOps \& Deployments: Deploy, roll back, and manage the lifecycle of containerized applications using ArgoCD pipeline workflows.
* Alert Triage \& Resolution: Act as the first line of defense to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure, OS\-level, application, and network alerts.

* OS Troubleshooting: Diagnose deep Operating System bottlenecks including CPU throttling, memory leaks, and storage constraints on GKE worker nodes.
* AIOps Utilization: Use AI\-driven operations tools to interpret correlated events, anomaly detections, and automated root\-cause insights.
* Incident Response: Participate in on\-call rotations, using Grafana dashboards and AIOps suggestions to quickly mitigate production container issues.


**Required Technical Skills:**
* CI/CD \& GitOps: Practical experience deploying and managing applications using ArgoCD and Git version control systems.
* Networking: Comprehensive knowledge of all layers of networking (OSI model), with practical troubleshooting skills in Layer 7 (Application): HTTP/S, DNS, gRPC, and SSL/TLS handshakes ; Layer 4 (Transport): TCP/UDP mechanics, three\-way handshakes, and port allocation; Layer 3 (Network): IP routing, CIDR blocks, Subnetting, and ICMP; Kubernetes Networking: Understanding of Pod\-to\-Pod communication, Services, Ingress controllers, and CNI plugins.
* Operating Systems: Strong, deep foundational knowledge of Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, or Container\-Optimized OS) internals, process management, file systems, and kernel parameters.
* System \& Network Utilities: Proficiency with command\-line diagnostic tools (e.g., tcpdump, curl, dig, traceroute, top, iostat).
* AIOps Concepts: Familiarity with AI\-driven operations, event correlation, anomaly detection, and automated noise reduction.
* Observability: Foundational experience with the Grafana Labs ecosystem (Grafana, Mimir/Prometheus, Loki, Tempo).
* Orchestration: Functional knowledge of deploying, scaling, and managing workloads in GKE.
* ML/AIOps (nice to have ) : Anomaly detection concepts , log\-based ML models
* Demonstrated experience writing automation scripts in Python, Bash, or Go


**Soft Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Problem Solving: Ability to systematically troubleshoot complex microservice and OS\-level issues under pressure.
* Urgency \& Prioritization: Strong sense of ownership and ability to prioritize alerts based on business impact.
* Analytical Mindset: Comfort working alongside data\-driven, automated recommendations to solve infrastructure problems.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication during high\-stress incident responses.

* India – (Flexible hybrid work model \- work from Bangalore office for 20 days in a quarter)
