title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.
   

  

**Why us?**
 🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry\-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.
   

  

 🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast\-paced, high\-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.
   

  

 🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.
   

  

 🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.
   

  

 💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting\-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.
   

  

 Milestones
   

  

* Set up the development environment, contribute first PRs under guidance, and build enough architectural understanding to describe the end\-to\-end pipeline — event ingestion, Data Lake zones, and REST API serving — clearly to a peer.
* Deliver well\-scoped tasks independently — bug fixes, test coverage gaps, and minor API endpoint additions — with the first Data Lake Bronze zone write task completed and consistent participation in squad ceremonies.
* Maintain consistent delivery quality on medium\-scope tasks, write tests without being prompted, and explain event consumer logic and REST API code to a new joiner without assistance. Complete AZ\-900 certification.
* Contribute a documented technical input to at least one system design discussion and demonstrate junior IC3\-level autonomy across delivery, testing, and code quality — ready for formal level progression review.


**Responsibilities**
 Development
   

  

* Implement bug fixes, small features, and test improvements in Python/FastAPI/Django under structured senior guidance.
* Write unit tests (pytest) for all developed code; learn to read coverage reports and identify branch coverage gaps.
* Study and apply squad coding standards: event schema conventions, Pydantic model patterns, REST API response formats, and Data Lake write templates.
* Participate in pair programming sessions as both driver and navigator, with defined learning goals each session.
* Read and document existing event consumer code, Data Lake transformation pipelines, and REST API implementations as part of onboarding.


 Architecture Exposure
   

  

* Attend all architecture reviews and design discussions as an active observer — taking notes, asking clarifying questions, and summarising key decisions in the squad wiki.
* Shadow senior engineers during system design whiteboarding — learning to read sequence diagrams, event flow maps, and Data Lake zone diagrams.
* Study the Lane 01 architecture map — understanding each microservice, event flow, Data Lake zone, and REST API surface in the full pipeline.
* Complete one self\-directed study of a core architectural pattern per quarter (e.g. Bronze/Silver/Gold Data Lake model, event\-driven saga, API versioning strategy) and present a short summary to the squad.


 Event\-Driven \& Data Lake Foundations
   

  

* Learn RabbitMQ consumer patterns by working within existing implementations — understanding exchange types, routing keys, acknowledgement modes, and dead\-letter queue behaviour.
* Implement Bronze zone write tasks: land raw documents to ADLS Gen2 with correct metadata and partitioning under senior guidance.
* Add Silver zone data quality validation rules — field validation checks and schema assertions — to existing transformation pipelines.
* Learn to read Event Hubs consumer lag metrics and offset commits during on\-call shadow rotations.


 REST API Foundations
   

  

* Implement minor FastAPI endpoint additions under senior review — applying Pydantic response models, HTTP status code conventions, and OpenAPI documentation standards.
* Write integration tests for assigned endpoints covering happy path, validation error, and auth failure scenarios.
* Contribute to OpenAPI documentation updates — parameter descriptions, example payloads, and error code references.
* Learn OAuth2/Azure AD token validation by working within existing FastAPI authentication middleware.


 Quality \& Growth
   

  

* Participate in code reviews — observer initially, then structured reviewer within 60 days.
* Complete mandatory certifications within 6 months: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\) and one Python testing or data engineering foundations course.
* Submit a monthly technical learning note to the squad wiki — a concept studied with a practical codebase example.
* Proactively surface blockers in standups; never sit on a blocker more than one working day without flagging.


**Requirements**
 Must Have
   

  

* 0–3 years of professional Python development (internships, contract work, and strong academic projects count).
* Solid Python fundamentals: data structures, OOP, error handling, list comprehensions, and basic async awareness.
* Exposure to at least one web framework — Django, FastAPI, Flask, or similar.
* REST API basics: HTTP methods, status codes, JSON request/response, and understanding of what an API endpoint does.
* Git fundamentals: commit, branch, pull request, and basic merge conflict resolution.
* Strong self\-directed learning instinct — able to demonstrate independently acquired technical skills with examples.
* Clear written English: PR descriptions, code comments, and documentation.


 Strong Plus
   

  

* Any hands\-on exposure to event\-driven systems — message queues, pub/sub, async tasks — in academic or project context.
* Basic Data Lake or data pipeline awareness: ETL, CSV/JSON file processing, any cloud storage interaction.
* Docker at basic level: build and run a container.
* Azure exposure at any level: AZ\-900 coursework, hands\-on projects, or certification.
* Open\-source contributions or a personal Python project portfolio.


**Interested?**
 If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.
   

  

 CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**About Us**
 Ctruh is a deep\-tech company building the infrastructure layer for the spatial internet through a proprietary browser\-native, no\-code 3D engine and VersaAI, our in\-house generative AI engine that transforms text, images, and video into production\-ready 3D assets in minutes.
   

  

**Our Work Rhythm**
**This is a 6\-day working setup with Monday to Friday operating from office and Saturday as Work From Home (WFH).**
 We believe this model enables stronger collaboration, faster learning, and better team alignment while maintaining flexibility.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a hands\-on
 **3D Generalist** 
 who can create high\-quality, real\-time optimized 3D assets that power immersive AR, VR, XR, and web experiences. You'll work closely with Product, Design, AI, and Engineering teams to build visually compelling assets that balance artistic excellence with technical performance.
   

  

 This role requires someone who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, enjoys solving creative and technical challenges, and can own the complete 3D asset pipeline, from concept and modeling to optimization and deployment. You'll play a key role in shaping the visual quality of Ctruh's immersive commerce platform while ensuring assets are production\-ready, scalable, and optimized for real\-time applications.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Design and develop high\-quality 3D models, product assets, environments, props, and scenes for AR, VR, XR, and web\-based experiences.
* Own the complete 3D asset pipeline including modeling, UV mapping, retopology, texturing, material creation, lighting, rendering, optimization, and export.
* Create production\-ready, real\-time optimized assets that maintain high visual quality while meeting performance requirements across browsers and devices.
* Build physically based rendering (PBR) materials and textures using industry\-standard workflows and tools.
* Develop immersive environments with strong composition, lighting, and visual storytelling principles.
* Optimize topology, texture resolution, polygon count, draw calls, and asset complexity for real\-time rendering.
* Export and maintain assets in .glb, .gltf, and other production\-ready formats compatible with web and XR platforms.
* Organize and maintain structured asset libraries, reusable resources, naming conventions, version control, and documentation.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, AI, and Engineering teams to translate creative concepts into technically feasible 3D experiences.
* Support developers during asset integration into Unreal Engine, WebXR, and browser\-based interactive applications.
* Continuously improve internal 3D workflows, asset quality standards, optimization techniques, and production efficiency.
* Stay updated with emerging trends in real\-time graphics, immersive technologies, procedural workflows, AI\-assisted content creation, and modern 3D pipelines.


**Must\-Haves**
**What You Bring:**
* 3\+ years of professional experience as a 3D Generalist, 3D Artist, or similar role.
* Strong proficiency in Blender.
* Experience with Substance Painter and Adobe Photoshop.
* Working knowledge of Unreal Engine.
* Strong understanding of PBR workflows, material creation, lighting, composition, and scene building.
* Experience creating production\-ready assets for real\-time rendering.
* Hands\-on experience with .glb/.gltf asset workflows.
* Strong understanding of topology optimization, UV mapping, texture baking, and mesh optimization.
* Ability to independently manage the complete 3D asset lifecycle from concept to deployment.
* Strong attention to detail with an eye for realism, aesthetics, and performance.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, product\-focused startup environment.


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience with WebXR, AR, VR, or immersive technology platforms.
* Basic knowledge of rigging, animation, and interaction workflows.
* Experience with product visualization, e\-commerce, or digital twin applications.
* Familiarity with procedural workflows and node\-based material creation.
* Understanding of browser\-based rendering constraints and performance optimization.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted 3D content creation tools and workflows.
* Experience collaborating with developers in interactive 3D product environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured by consistently delivering high\-quality, production\-ready 3D assets, improving rendering performance across web and XR platforms, establishing scalable asset pipelines and reusable workflows, reducing asset optimization bottlenecks, and earning strong feedback from Product, Design, Engineering, and Leadership teams.
   

  

**Who Will Thrive Here**
 You are a creative, technically strong, and highly detail\-oriented 3D artist who enjoys building immersive digital experiences. You understand both artistic quality and real\-time performance, balancing visual storytelling with technical optimization.
   

  

 You thrive in startup environments, adapt quickly to changing priorities, take ownership from concept to deployment, and are excited about building the future of immersive commerce through high\-quality 3D content.
   

  

**Why Join Ctruh**
 At Ctruh, you'll work on cutting\-edge AI, AR, VR, XR, and immersive commerce technologies while helping build the future of browser\-native 3D experiences. You'll enjoy significant ownership, collaborate directly with founders and core product teams, influence the visual direction of next\-generation products, and have the opportunity to grow into senior technical or creative leadership roles while solving meaningful real\-world challenges.

title: AR, VR and AI: Using New Technologies To Create Competitive Advantage
description:
As technology continues to become more and more prevalent in our everyday lives, it is important for us to learn the differences between new computer systems and the ways in which they can be used to capture value. All too often, businesses will adjust to and learn to implement only one kind of technology, just for another newer and preferred platform to come along and force them to start this process all over again. Marketers need to be consistently looking to the future and staying up to date on these innovations in order to determine the most practical applications for their companies.
   

  

 There Are Three Types Of Technology That We As Marketers Will Be Using More Frequently (and Much Sooner Than You May Think)
   

  

* Augmented Reality (AR) involves virtual enhancement of a real\-world environment. AR systems identify existing objects and conditions, and then augment them with superimposed, computer\-generated imagery. AR includes technology like Snapchat filters, the Uber app and Pokémon Go.
* Virtual Reality (VR) uses an interactive, artificial world to suspend doubt in the user. VR systems combine software and hardware to create some degree of immersion and sensory feedback. Most video games involve some level of VR immersion.
* Artificial Intelligence (AI) adds adaptive learning and/or intelligence to computers so that performance is improved. Computers with AI capabilities can learn from experience, adjust to new inputs and perform some human\-like tasks using data collection and storage. AI encompasses anything from smart speakers to self\-driving cars.


*But how do we use this information to create competitive advantage?*
 The increasing accessibility of information through social media—and internet usage in general—has opened the door for many companies looking to differentiate their offerings through personalization.
   

  

* Augmenting Customer Realities: By tailoring your company’s products or services for use on AR equipped platforms, customers will be able to view your offering in their physical environment. Ikea’s “IKEA Place” app does this particularly well, allowing customers to preview furniture wherever they plan to place it in their homes.
* Using the Past to Inform the Future: Data collected by retailers about customers’ historical information from past purchases can be used to create deeper engagement at home or in\-store. Companies will be able to suggest and possibly even predict future purchase decisions with the use of AI.
* Increasing Interest through Interaction: Consumers are becoming less and less interested by traditional advertising in mass markets. It is no longer enough for brands to include a prominent celebrity or an adorable animal in their ad. Advertisements through VR platforms will allow for seemingly real user\-product interaction and will likely be more successful in influencing purchase decisions in the coming years.


 How will your brand use these tools to capture value for your audience? Tell us how by tweeting us @DEVENEYMKTG

title: Director of 3D Engineering
description:
**About Us**
 Ctruh is a deep\-tech company building the infrastructure layer for the spatial internet through a proprietary browser\-native, no\-code 3D engine and VersaAI, our in\-house generative AI engine that transforms text, images, and video into production\-ready 3D assets in minutes.
   

  

**Our Work Rhythm**
**This is a 6\-day working setup with Monday to Friday operating from office and Saturday as Work From Home (WFH).**
 We believe this model enables stronger collaboration, faster learning, and better team alignment while maintaining flexibility.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an exceptional Director of 3D Engineering to lead and scale Ctruh's next\-generation real\-time graphics and 3D platform. This role sits at the intersection of graphics engineering, rendering architecture, and technical leadership, where you'll define the long\-term vision for browser\-native 3D experiences, lead senior engineering teams, and build world\-class rendering systems that power AI, AR, XR, and immersive commerce.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoys solving large\-scale graphics challenges while mentoring high\-performing engineering teams. You'll work closely with Product, AI, Design, and Leadership teams to transform ambitious ideas into scalable, high\-performance 3D platforms used across web and immersive technologies.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Define the long\-term technical vision and architecture for Ctruh's browser\-native 3D platform and real\-time rendering systems.
* Lead the development of high\-performance rendering pipelines using WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL, and modern graphics technologies.
* Architect scalable rendering systems for web, desktop, mobile, AR, and XR experiences while maintaining visual consistency across platforms.
* Design advanced rendering pipelines including PBR workflows, shader systems, material pipelines, lighting models, and GPU optimization strategies.
* Build rendering architectures that consistently deliver smooth, high\-quality graphics across multiple device tiers while maintaining target frame rates.
* Establish scalable performance optimization frameworks including LOD systems, instancing, batching, culling, adaptive rendering, memory optimization, and GPU profiling.
* Architect end\-to\-end 3D asset pipelines covering ingestion, validation, optimization, compression, streaming, caching, and progressive loading.
* Build robust support for industry\-standard asset formats including glTF, USDZ, FBX, OBJ, and Collada while ensuring scalability across large asset libraries.
* Define engineering standards, rendering quality benchmarks, testing frameworks, and platform\-wide best practices.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a world\-class graphics engineering team while fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Drive research and development initiatives across next\-generation graphics technologies including WebGPU, ray tracing, path tracing, neural rendering, photogrammetry, procedural materials, and AI\-assisted rendering.
* Collaborate closely with Product, AI, Design, Infrastructure, and Leadership teams to align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and continuously evolve Ctruh's graphics platform to remain at the forefront of browser\-native 3D innovation.


**Must\-Haves**
**What You Bring:**
* 7\+ years of professional experience in graphics engineering, rendering systems, or real\-time 3D platform development.
* Proven experience architecting and building large\-scale graphics platforms or rendering engines.
* Deep expertise in WebGL, OpenGL, and modern real\-time rendering pipelines.
* Advanced proficiency in GLSL shader development, GPU programming concepts, and rendering optimization.
* Strong understanding of Physically Based Rendering (PBR), BRDF models, lighting systems, GPU architecture, and graphics memory optimization.
* Excellent foundation in 3D mathematics, including vectors, matrices, transformations, quaternions, and linear algebra.
* Experience building highly scalable, performance\-critical graphics infrastructure.
* Strong architectural thinking with the ability to design complex distributed graphics systems.
* Proven leadership experience managing and mentoring senior engineering teams.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Excellent communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills.


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience with WebGPU and modern browser graphics APIs.
* Strong understanding of Unity or Unreal Engine rendering internals.
* Experience building 3D configurators, Digital Twins, product visualization platforms, or immersive commerce solutions.
* Background in advanced rendering research including ray tracing, path tracing, global illumination, and neural rendering.
* Experience with photogrammetry, 3D scanning, procedural content generation, or AI\-powered rendering workflows.
* Contributions to open\-source graphics, rendering, or browser\-engine projects.
* Experience building graphics infrastructure for large\-scale production environments.


**Tools You'll Use**
 You will work with tools such as WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL, Three.js, Babylon.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Blender, RenderDoc, GPU profiling tools, Git, Notion, and Google Workspace while collaborating closely with Product, AI, Design, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured by delivering a scalable, high\-performance browser\-native 3D platform, achieving industry\-leading rendering quality and GPU performance, enabling seamless cross\-platform experiences, establishing world\-class graphics engineering practices, building a high\-performing engineering team, and driving continuous innovation in real\-time rendering technologies.
   

  

**Why Join Ctruh**
 At Ctruh, you'll lead the future of browser\-native 3D experiences by building cutting\-edge graphics technology that powers AI, XR, and immersive commerce at scale. You'll work on some of the industry's most challenging real\-time rendering problems while shaping the architecture of a platform designed for millions of users.
   

  

 You'll collaborate directly with leadership, influence long\-term technical strategy, build and mentor a world\-class graphics engineering organization, and work with cutting\-edge technologies backed by leading ecosystem partners including NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Google. This is a rare opportunity to define the future of browser\-based graphics while solving meaningful engineering challenges at global scale.
   

  

**Who Will Thrive Here**
 You are a visionary graphics engineer who combines deep technical expertise with exceptional leadership. You think in rendering pipelines, GPU architectures, shaders, and system design while maintaining a relentless focus on performance, scalability, and engineering excellence.
   

  

 You thrive on solving complex graphics challenges, enjoy mentoring world\-class engineers, and are passionate about pushing the boundaries of browser\-native 3D technology. You take ownership, embrace innovation, and are excited to build the next generation of immersive experiences that redefine what's possible on the web.

title: Engineer I, Smart Switch Software Development
description:
**Department:** 
 Enterprise Engineering — Smart Switch Software Development
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About NETGEAR**
 NETGEAR has been pioneering advanced networking technology since 1996, delivering innovative products that connect people to the internet, power businesses, and enable digital experiences. Our Smart Switch product line serves small\-to\-medium businesses and enterprises worldwide, offering advanced L2/L3 managed switching with cloud\-based management through NETGEAR Insight. We are building a new engineering center in Chennai to drive the next generation of our smart switch firmware platform.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an Engineer I to join our Smart Switch firmware team in Chennai. This is an entry\-level role designed for early\-career engineers who are passionate about embedded systems and networking, and who want to grow into deep technical experts on production\-grade switch firmware.
   

  

 You will work alongside senior engineers on the core firmware that powers NETGEAR's smart switch product families across multiple ARM64 and MIPS hardware platforms. Your day\-to\-day will span low\-level embedded C development, Linux kernel modules and device drivers, and the implementation of L2/L3 networking protocols that move real customer traffic in real networks.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who is curious about how networks work at the packet level, comfortable reading datasheets and IEEE/IETF standards, and excited to debug problems that span hardware, kernel, and application layers. You will receive structured mentorship, clear ownership of well\-scoped features, and the runway to grow toward Engineer II within 18\-24 months.
   

  

 As the industry shifts toward AI\-augmented development, we expect every engineer on the team — including new graduates — to use AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of their daily workflow for code generation, debugging, learning, and accelerating ramp\-up.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Embedded C Development: Write, debug, and maintain embedded C code for user\-space daemons, shared libraries, and Linux kernel modules running on resource\-constrained ARM64 and MIPS switch platforms. Follow team coding standards and learn to write code that is efficient, defensive, and production\-ready.
* Drivers \& Platform Bring\-Up: Assist senior engineers in developing and maintaining device drivers, board support package (BSP) code, and the hardware abstraction layer (HAL) that connects the switch ASIC SDK to higher\-level firmware components.
* L2/L3 Protocol Work: Implement well\-scoped pieces of L2/L3 networking features under guidance — VLANs, STP/RSTP, LLDP, IGMP snooping, LACP, ACLs. Read the relevant IEEE/IETF standards, study existing code, and ship correct, conformant implementations.
* Bug Fixes \& Debugging: Take ownership of bug tickets from the field and internal QA — reproduce on hardware, isolate root cause across kernel, driver, and application layers, and deliver fixes with regression coverage. Use GDB, strace, kernel logs, tcpdump, and Wireshark as everyday tools.
* Hardware Lab Work: Work hands\-on with switch hardware in the lab — serial console, traffic generators, packet capture, JTAG when needed. Learn to validate firmware behavior on real hardware before merge.
* Code Reviews \& Learning: Participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer. Ask good questions, document what you learn, and grow your understanding of the full firmware stack over time.
* AI\-Augmented Development: Use AI coding agents daily to accelerate ramp\-up, generate boilerplate, explore unfamiliar code, draft tests, and assist with debugging. Develop the judgment to know when to trust AI output and when to verify against datasheets, standards, and hardware behavior.

**What We Are Looking For**
* B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech/M.E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, or a related field
* 0\-2 years of professional experience
* Strong programming fundamentals in C — pointers, memory management, structs, bit manipulation, and the standard library
* Working knowledge of Linux as a development environment — shell, GCC toolchain, GDB, Make, Git
* Foundational understanding of computer networks — OSI model, Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP, ARP, VLANs, subnetting
* Familiarity with operating system concepts — processes, threads, scheduling, interrupts, memory layout
* Curiosity about embedded systems and a willingness to read datasheets, standards documents, and existing codebases
* Comfort using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in academic projects, internships, or personal work
* Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to collaborate effectively with team members across time zones


**Preferred**

* Exposure to Linux kernel internals — kernel modules, character devices, /proc and /sys interfaces, or basic driver development
* Hands\-on work with networking labs — configuring switches/routers, packet capture with Wireshark or tcpdump, building a small network
* Familiarity with any L2 protocol at an implementation level (e.g., a class project that implemented STP, ARP, or a simple router)

title: Lead Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**The Role**




 We’re seeking an
 **Embedded Systems Engineer** 
 to build the intelligence layer of our modular indoor farming systems. This is not a maintenance role.
 
 You will own the complete electronics and embedded stack of our farming units. You will be responsible for setting up the architecture, building a large part of it yourself.
 




  





**About Us**




 Humanity must produce more food in the next four decades than we have in the last 8,000 years of agriculture combined.
 



 At Cosy, we are redesigning farming as a controlled, modular, and scalable system built next to where people live. We believe food production should be precise, reliable, and repeatable \- not dependent on weather or distance.
 



 We are building environmental control machines that grow food.
 



  





**Location: Goregaon, Mumbai.**




  





**Who You Are**



* You are a hands\-on embedded systems builder.
* You’ve shipped real hardware.
* You’ve debugged field failures.
* You understand that controlling physical systems is very different from writing software.
* You think in systems:
* Sensors → Control Logic → Actuators → Safety → Data → Deployment.
* You care about reliability more than features.
* You are comfortable making architecture decisions.
* You take ownership.



  





**What You’ll Own**



* **Electronics hardware** 
 \- PCB design from schematic to bring\-up, and the control panel that runs each unit (power, protection, wiring, connectors)
* **Firmwar** 
 e \- real\-time control in C/C\+\+ on ESP32 microcontrollers: sensing, actuation, fail\-safes, OTA updates
* **Control logic** 
 \- the algorithms that actually grow the crop: dosing, calibration routines, climate behaviour, safety interlocks
* **Connectivity** 
 \- MQTT/cloud telemetry, alarms, and the data interface between firmware and our farm software
* **Production and field \-** 
 testing and QC of every unit before dispatch, commissioning at hotel sites, debugging live deployments
* **Engineering standards** 
 \- schematics, wiring documentation, firmware architecture and version control, so the system outlives any one person



  





**Requirements**



* 3\-6 years of experience in embedded systems / hardware automation
* Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ and python for microcontrollers
* Experience working with microcontrollers (ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi or similar)
* Understanding of real\-time control systems and non\-blocking architecture
* Experience integrating sensors and controlling actuators
* Knowledge of communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, MQTT)
* Basic understanding of power electronics and hardware debugging
* Experience deploying hardware systems outside of lab environments



  





**Strongly Preferred**



* RTOS experience
* Experience in robotics, EV systems, industrial automation, or IoT hardware startups
* Experience designing systems that require high reliability
* Exposure to cloud integration for IoT systems



  





**What We Offer**



* High ownership from day one
* Direct impact on core product architecture
* Opportunity to build a scalable environmental control system from the ground up
* Collaborative, hands\-on startup environment
* Fresh herbs to take home

description:
**Do you want to be part of the team that revolutionizes resource exploration through quantum sensing?** 









 Atomionics is working on quantum sensors based on atom\-interferometry where atoms are cooled down to almost absolute zero using lasers. At such cold temperatures, the wave nature of atoms becomes prominent, which allows us to precisely measure the forces acting on them. This opens up a wide range of applications, including paving a path in the energy transition to zero\-carbon and transforming resource exploration and geophysical surveying.
 



  
 



**Headquartered in Singapore, Atomionics is now expanding its footprint to India, with our India operations anchored in the Amaravati Quantum Valley.** 
 As part of our India team, you will work closely with our Singapore headquarters, collaborating across borders while building deep tech capabilities locally, with our India team playing a critical role in field deployment of our Quantum Gravimeters.
 



  
 



 At Atomionics, you will get the chance to design, prototype, test, refine, finalize, and produce your designs, developing solutions that improve our sensor's performance while making it compact and robust for field deployment. You will also play a critical role in supporting deployment and conducting field trials with Quantum Gravimeters. We are looking for an Mechanical Design Engineer who:
 


* wants the freedom to innovate by being involved in deep tech research
* is excited by the prospect of working within an interdisciplinary team comprised of physicists, electronics engineers, and software engineers



  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Conduct field trials and deployment of atom\-interferometry based Quantum Gravimeters, including on\-site setup, operation, and troubleshooting
* Conduct PCB\-level maintenance, debugging, and design iterations to keep hardware performing as required in the field
* Conduct electronics system assembly, integration, and testing of our gravimeters ahead of and during deployment
* Work closely with the physics \& firmware teams in cross\-functional projects
* Propose and implement new innovative solutions and technologies



  





**About you** 



* Practical experience with electronics projects, ideally with some exposure to schematic capture and PCB design (e.g. KiCAD)
* Working knowledge of analog and digital circuit design
* Comfortable with prototyping, debugging, and performance testing of boards
* Component knowledge and selection
* Familiarity with microcontroller/microprocessor\-based systems
* Working knowledge of common interfaces (SPI, I2C, RS232, USB, CAN, etc.)
* Willingness to travel for field deployments and work in on\-site/field conditions



  





**Even better if you have** 



* Exposure to power electronics or signal processing circuit design
* Firmware, embedded systems, and programming experience
* FPGA \& DDS experience
* Keen attention to detail and creative problem solving



  





**How to Apply** 




 If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we'd love to hear from you! Apply directly through our careers page at www.atomionics.com or send your resume to careers@atomionics.com or mitha@atomionics.com. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Drone Engineer — UAV Design & Flight Testing | Drone R&D | Chennai
description:
**Cams Biometrics \- Shollinganallur, OMR, Chennai \- Experience: 4\+yrs \- Salary: Up to 7\.2 LPA (No deductions)** 




  





 We are building a drone platform from the ground up at Cams Biometrics, Chennai.
 **From UAV to Manned Vehicle.** 
 This is our primary long\-term product line, not a side project. This is a
 **hands\-on role in a close\-knit team** 
 . You will be selecting motors, routing power, wiring flight controllers, tuning PIDs, and standing in a field watching the aircraft fly — then working out with the team why it did what it did.
 



 You will work alongside our hardware and electronics engineers, and directly with the founder. Drone development does not happen in isolation — airframe decisions change the power budget, the power budget changes the payload, the payload changes the flight envelope. We want someone who thinks across those boundaries
 **with other people** 
 , not around them.
 



 We are a small team building something ambitious. Everyone here has real ownership, and everyone helps everyone.
 


 What you'll own
 * **Airframe** 
 — configuration selection, structures, materials, weight budget, vibration management
* **Propulsion \& power** 
 — motor and ESC sizing, propeller matching, battery and BMS architecture, power distribution, thrust\-to\-weight and endurance calculations
* **Avionics** 
 — flight controller selection and integration (Pixhawk / PX4 / ArduPilot or custom), IMU/GPS/sensor integration, telemetry and RF links, failsafe design
* **Payload integration** 
 — camera and compute module mounting, gimbal/vibration isolation, payload power and data paths, release mechanisms for delivery
* **Flight test** 
 — bench testing, tethered testing, field testing, log analysis, iteration
* **The path to production** 
 — BOM ownership, vendor sourcing, DGCA regulatory pathway, and design\-for\-manufacture as we scale



 You will lead the drone side of this — but not alone. Our electronics engineers own the boards and firmware, and you will work with them daily on power, sensors, and payload integration.
 



  




 What we're actually looking for
 
**We care far more about what you have built than how many years you have.** 




 If you have personally taken a drone from a blank sheet to something that flies reliably — as a job, a startup, a university team, or in your own workshop — we want to talk to you.
 



**Essential:** 



* You have
 **designed and built a working drone from scratch** 
 — not assembled a kit, not flown a DJI. You chose the frame, sized the motors and props, wired the power system, integrated the flight controller, and got it airborne.
* You have
 **tuned a flight controller** 
 yourself — PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight or equivalent — and can explain what you changed and why
* You have
 **diagnosed a real flight failure** 
 — a crash, a flyaway, an unexplained yaw drift — and traced it to a root cause
* You are comfortable with
 **power system design** 
 : battery sizing, current draw under load, C\-ratings, ESC selection, and why a drone browns out mid\-flight
* You can read a
 **datasheet and a flight log** 
 with equal fluency



**Strongly preferred:** 



* Payload integration experience — camera, LiDAR, sensor or delivery mechanism
* Experience with onboard compute for vision/AI (Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Coral, Hailo)
* Custom PCB work for drone subsystems — power distribution boards, ESC carriers, sensor breakouts
* Fixed\-wing
 *and* 
 multirotor exposure
* Any experience with DGCA regulations, drone certification, or flight permissions
* Long\-range RF / telemetry link design



**What we are not looking for:** 



* Drone
 *pilots* 
 without design and build experience
* People who have only worked with off\-the\-shelf platforms
* People who prefer to work alone — this role is collaborative and hands\-on every day


 Why this role is interesting
 * **Real product, real timeline.** 
 The delivery drone is funded and moving. Military and human\-carry platforms follow.
* **You see the whole aircraft.** 
 Not one subsystem in a 40\-person org — you work across airframe, power, avionics and payload, with the people who own the adjacent pieces.
* **A hardware team being built alongside you.** 
 We are hiring electronics engineers in parallel. You will have genuine collaborators, not handoffs over a wall.
* **Direct access.** 
 You work with the founder daily. Decisions get made in the room, not in a steering committee.
* **AI\-native tooling.** 
 We use AI tools seriously across design and development, and we expect you to as well.

title: Associate Product Manager - Acquisition
description:
This role owns how new users discover and enter our lending platform sourcing and evaluating new acquisition channels, running structured POCs to test them, and improving the onboarding and activation funnel once users arrive. Alongside this, you'll own the standard product responsibilities: writing PRDs, coordinating delivery with Engineering and Design, and driving decisions with data.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Identify, evaluate, and pilot new acquisition channels affiliates, aggregators, DSAs, co lending/embedded finance partners, referral programs, WhatsApp/voice\-based sourcing, offline to\-online funnels, and emerging paid/organic channels
* Design and run structured POCs for new channels: define the hypothesis, success metrics, timeline, and clear scale\-or\-kill criteria before recommending full rollout
* Own and optimize the customer acquisition funnel across web and app journeys from first touch through onboarding and activation
* Evaluate channel and campaign performance using CAC and payback period not just volume or cost\-per\-lead to judge whether a channel is worth scaling
* Track lead quality and downstream funnel health for new channels \- bureau hit rate, approval rate, rejection rate, and fraud signals
* Evaluate and onboard new sourcing partners and vendors, including commercial terms, integration scope, and SLAs
* Define product requirements, write user stories and PRDs, and coordinate with Engineering and Design for feature delivery
* Apply user segmentation, attribution, and experimentation frameworks (A/B testing) to optimize acquisition performance
* Partner closely with Growth, Marketing, Business, Risk/Credit, Compliance, Partnerships/BD, Analytics, and Engineering to improve acquisition outcomes end\-to\-end



  





**What we're looking for:** 



* 1–2 years of experience in Product, Business Analysis, preferably in fintech, lending, or consumer internet products
* Understanding of customer acquisition funnels across web and app journeys, with the ability to identify onboarding and activation improvements
* Familiarity with acquisition channels, lead generation journeys, and optimization of user onboarding experiences, along with genuine curiosity to explore and test new, unproven channels
* Working understanding of unit economics in acquisition \- CAC, payback period \- and how they inform channel investment decisions
* Exposure to the broader lending/credit funnel (application → KYC → underwriting → disbursal) or willingness to learn it quickly, since acquisition quality here is judged beyond signup
* Awareness of basic regulatory and compliance guardrails relevant to digital lending sourcing (consent, data\-sharing norms, DSA/agent compliance where applicable)
* Data\-driven mindset with basic SQL skills and the ability to analyze acquisition funnels, campaign performance, and user behavior using Mixpanel, Tableau, or Excel
* Familiarity with attribution/MMP tools such as AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust for multi\-channel tracking.
* Ability to define product requirements, write user stories, and coordinate with Engineering and Design for feature delivery
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate acquisition metrics, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements
* Understanding of user segmentation, attribution, and experimentation frameworks to optimize acquisition performance
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to create PRDs, business requirement documents, and structured proposals
* High ownership mindset with the ability to independently manage features and stakeholder requirements.



  





**About Kissht:** 




 Kissht is India's leading listed fintech companies, offering fast, personalized digital credit through its mobile app to customers across the country. Founded in 2016 by IIT/IIM alumni Ranvir Singh and Krishnan Vishwanathan, both former McKinsey consultants, Kissht was listed on the NSE and BSE in May 2026 with a market capitalization of approximately ₹5,200 crore.
 



  





 Kissht serves 74\.6 million registered users and 12\.25 million customers, with assets under management (AUM) of approximately ₹8,000 crore. Its growth is powered by proprietary AI/ML\-based underwriting, a robust in\-house technology stack, and a pan\-India collections network.
 



 Headquartered in Mumbai and backed by marquee investors, including the Brunei Investment Authority, Vertex Growth Fund, and the Government of Singapore, Kissht is now scaling as a public company and is looking for driven, entrepreneurial talent to join its next phase of growth.

title: Associate Product Manager/ Product Manager – Supply Chain
description:
**About The Team**
 Purplle's Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e\-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a lean team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own our Warehouse Management System (WMS) and internal supply chain tools as the core of the role, while also driving our ERP integration and our data platforms for reporting and data warehousing. You will work at the intersection of product, operations, and data, turning the needs of warehouse stakeholders into reliable, well\-built features. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with the data engineering, backend engineering, and analytics teams, as well as operations and business stakeholders, to deliver the roadmap.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Warehouse Management and Internal Tools
   

  

 Own the product roadmap for the WMS and adjacent internal tools used by warehouse teams.
   

  

 Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
   

  

 Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
   

  

 Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground, then define structured improvements that scale.
   

  

 ERP Systems
   

  

 Support the integration and data consistency between the WMS and the ERP for sales, inventory, and reconciliation flows.
   

  

 Work with engineering and operations to debug system\-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.
   

  

 Help define and validate the impact of ERP\-related product changes.
   

  

 Data Platforms, Reporting, and Data Warehousing
   

  

 Lead the reporting and data warehousing layer that gives stakeholders a single, reliable source of truth.
   

  

 Coordinate with the data engineering team on ETL processes and pipelines that feed the warehouse.
   

  

 Build and maintain dashboards and reports covering inventory positions, stock movements, reconciliation health, and system performance.
   

  

 Use data analysis to surface insights and drive data\-informed product decisions.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills And Requirements**
 1\+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply\-chain technology role.
   

  

 BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
   

  

 Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
   

  

 Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
   

  

 Familiarity with ETL processes and pipelines and how data moves from source systems into a data warehouse.
   

  

 Ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, and to think and work in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities.
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, and business teams.
   

  

 High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.
   

  

 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

 Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems and ERP systems, and an understanding of how inventory and sales data flow between them.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
   

  

 Experience with SAP or a similar enterprise ERP.
   

  

 Exposure to inventory management, or quick\-commerce and dark\-store operations.
   

  

 Familiarity with pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow.
   

  

 What You Will Gain
   

  

 End\-to\-end ownership of the WMS and internal tools that run day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
   

  

 A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
   

  

 Deep exposure to ERP integration and to building the data platform behind business\-critical reporting.
   

  

 A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.
   

  

**About Company**
 Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000\+ brands, 60,000\+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
   

  

 Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000\+ offline touchpoints and launched 100\+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third\-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend\-driven, high\-quality beauty essentials.
   

  

 What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper\-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer\-first approach.
   

  

 In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
   

  

 With a 3,000\+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

description:
**About Snapmint** 




 India’s booming consumer market has over 300 million credit\-eligible consumers, yet only 35 million actively use credit cards. At Snapmint, we’re reimagining how credit works—with a product\-first approach that puts the consumer experience at the center. Our EMI and Pay Later solutions are designed from the ground up to be intuitive, accessible, and frictionless—enabling millions of Indians to purchase what they need, when they need it, whether it’s fashion, electronics, or daily essentials.
 



  





 From seamless onboarding to instant approvals and zero\-cost EMIs, all our products are engineered to empower users while maintaining transparency and trust. We believe that enduring financial services are built not just on fair terms, but also on products that solve real problems with simplicity and scale.
 



 Founded in 2017, Snapmint is now India’s leading online zero\-cost EMI provider. With over 10 million consumers served across 2,500 cities—and doubling year on year—our growth is a direct outcome of building a world\-class online product that people love and rely on.

 read here

* Exposure to payments, KYC/compliance workflows, and order lifecycle management

title: Manager, Information Technology - Business & Product Management
description:
**Our Digital Transformation**
 The Coca Cola Company is evolving into a more digital first, data driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in technology, data, and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate The Coca\-Cola Company (TCCC) system’s next chapter of growth by reimagining our core competitive advantages. Building on a strong foundation of modernized infrastructure, global digital experiences, early data capabilities, and proven use cases, we are now shifting from early wins to scaled, end to end impact on growth, productivity, and efficiency. This next phase moves us from an analog world to a fully digitized one, powered by a digital growth engine that embeds data, technology, and AI into our most critical business domains. Success will require more than technology implementation, it demands a strategic transformation of core capabilities, a domain based, product centric operating model, and a cultural shift toward experimentation, data and technology fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Manager, Information Technology \- Business and Product Management will help connect business priorities with technology solutions that deliver measurable value in Manufacturing IT environment. This role acts as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, vendors, and service providers. The role is responsible for translating business needs into product priorities, roadmaps, portfolio decisions, and technology outcomes, while supporting effective escalation management and value realization. This position is ideal for a business\-facing information technology professional who understands how to balance customer needs, operational priorities, workplace technology, manufacturing environments, vendor delivery, financial discipline, and digital transformation. The successful candidate will bring strong product management capability, practical technology fluency, excellent communication skills, and the ability to drive results in a cross\-functional manufacturing environment. This role helps ensuring technology products and services are aligned to business capability needs, governed effectively, and continuously improved through data, insight, and collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, finance, architecture, delivery teams, and technology partners.
   

  

**What You Will Do For Us**
* Lead business engagement by partnering with business stakeholders to understand priorities, pain points, operational needs, and opportunities for technology\-enabled improvement.
* Translate business requirements into product priorities, technology outcomes, roadmap plans, and investment recommendations that support measurable business value.
* Develop and manage product roadmaps aligned to business capability needs, portfolio priorities, operational readiness, and financial planning.
* Own product outcomes, adoption, user value, business impact, and product\-related escalations for assigned technology services or capabilities.
* Use governance, prioritization methods, and performance insights to improve product outcomes, business alignment, and decision\-making.
* Assess the business and product impact of incidents, ensuring appropriate stakeholder communication, escalation support, and alignment with vendors and technical resolution teams.
* Support change prioritization, release readiness, business adoption, governance decisions, and stakeholder alignment for technology changes.
* Support business capability development and digital product evolution through value\-based investment decisions and coordination across delivery, architecture, finance, and operations teams.
* Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers that support product delivery, roadmap execution, workplace technology, manufacturing solutions, or business outcomes.
* Coordinate with management teams, vendors, and service providers to resolve issues, support service quality, and improve delivery performance.
* Use business, product, adoption, financial, operational, and value realization metrics to determine priorities and influence portfolio decisions.
* Apply artificial intelligence insights and data\-driven analysis to support prioritization, product decisions, service improvement, and business value creation.
* Ensure product priorities and delivery decisions align with governance, risk, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology standards.
* Support business case development, investment planning, portfolio prioritization, value realization, and management of operating expense and capital expenditure budgets.
* Influence product portfolio priorities, business capability investment, and strategic technology planning within the relevant business and technology scope.
* Bring awareness of manufacturing systems and applications to support operational environments, business continuity, and practical technology decision\-making.


**Requirements And Qualifications Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience working in Information Technology, preferably in business\-facing technology, product management, workplace technology, manufacturing technology, service delivery, or a related environment.
* Practical knowledge of end\-user and workplace technology services, including personal computers, deskside support, Microsoft and Apple operating systems, remote desktop protocol, virtual desktop infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Office, email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Knowledge of output management solutions, including multifunction printers, secure print, label printers, and network printers.
* Familiarity with manufacturing systems, manufacturing applications, or technology used to support production or bottling environments.
* Experience in product management, business relationship management, roadmap planning, portfolio management, and agile delivery.
* Experience leading a team or workstream, motivating others, driving execution, and delivering results in a cross\-functional environment.
* Proven ability to develop information technology solutions that address complex business problems and enable measurable outcomes.
* Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to translate stakeholder needs into product priorities, technology requirements, and actionable plans.
* Experience coordinating with management, vendors, service providers, and technology partners to support delivery quality, service performance, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology governance, prioritization, change readiness, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and service management practices.
* Ability to use data, metrics, analytics, and financial indicators to guide prioritization, measure adoption, and support continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and automation concepts, with the ability to apply insights appropriately to product management, decision\-making, and service improvement.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, including experience supporting business cases, investment planning, operating expense budgets, capital expenditure budgets, and value realization.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and escalation management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across levels and functions.
* Structured, organized, pragmatic, and practical working style with strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and sound decision\-making.
* Full professional English proficiency, including clear written and verbal communication.
* Bottler, manufacturing, consumer goods, or operational technology experience strongly preferred.


**Reporting Line:** 
 Director, Information Technology \- Business \& Product Management
   

  

**Location(s):**
 India
   

  

**City/Cities**
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Travel Required**
 00% \- 25%
   

  

**Relocation Provided:**
 No
   

  

**Job Posting End Date**
 August 21, 2026
   

  

**Our Purpose And Growth Culture**
 We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130\+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca\-Cola.

* Position: Product Manager, Zudo

**About Airblack \& Zudo** 




  





 Airblack is India’s largest alternate skilling platform, helping people become microentrepreneurs and creators. Our mission is to help the next 100 million people in the workforce get access to meaningful opportunities.
 



  





 We currently operate in sectors such as beauty, fashion, nutrition, digital \& home businesses, impacting over 1M learners every month. Our flagship school in the beauty space is India’s \#1 Beauty Academy brand, with an alumni base of over 40,000 entrepreneurs in 300\+ cities in India. Our apps consistently rank in top 10 education apps in India with 1M\+ users and 40M\+ minutes of learning content being consumed every month.
 



  





 Airblack has raised Rs. 100cr\+ from marquee investors such as Elevation Capital, Info Edge Ventures, Michael \& Susan Dell Foundation, Blume Founders Fund and Better Capital, and leading angels such as Vidit (Meesho), Kunal (CRED), Deepinder (Zomato), Harshit \& Shashank (Razorpay) and so on.
 



  





 One of our new products, Zudo, is now India’s fastest growing apps in the skilling / content space. Built with the mission of helping people get access to meaningful opportunities, it offers microcourses across Social media, Beauty, Fashion and other digital businesses. Few numbers:
 



  




* 10M downloads / 1M MAU / growing 100% QoQ
* Over 50,000 businesses already launched in beauty / fashion / nutrition / digital sectors



  





**What would you be doing?** 




  





 Own the product roadmap for a rocketship growing 100% MoM. We're at 1M MAU and need to hit 5M in 6 months without breaking things.
 



  




* **AI\-powered product strategy:** 
 Define and ship AI\-first features such as \- personalized learning paths, smart recommendations, conversational tutors and automated assessments.
* **Drive hyper\-growth metrics:** 
 Own user growth and engagement. Drive improvements in user retention across all time horizons. Optimize free\-to\-paid conversion. Reduce customer acquisition costs through product\-led growth while increasing lifetime value.
* **Run experiments at scale:** 
 Ship experiments across onboarding, discovery, engagement and monetization. Build a robust testing framework for rapid prototyping and testing.
* **Scale the platform:** 
 Build creator tools and AI\-assisted content workflows to 10x content velocity. Design marketplace dynamics \- matching algorithms, quality scoring, discovery, creator incentives. Expand to 30\+ categories. Create features that improve with scale (network effects, data moats, content flywheel).
* **Lead cross\-functional teams:** 
 Work directly with founders on strategy and OKRs. Lead pods of 8\-10 people across engineering, design, analytics, growth, content. Establish product culture: user obsession, bias for speed, data\-driven decisions, extreme ownership.



  





**What makes you a suitable candidate?** 




  





**Core background:** 




  




* 4\-10 years in product, with 3\+ years at high\-growth consumer startups (spaces such as consumer AI, edtech, social/content, travel, fintech, marketplace preferred)
* Proven 0→1 and 1→100 experience \- shipped products from scratch and scaled to millions
* Track record of impact with numbers: "increased retention by 35%", "drove $2M ARR",
* Built and shipped AI/ML features (recommendations, personalization, NLP, LLM applications)
* Have done cross\-functional execution in the past: aligned eng, design, growth, content around shared goals
* Strong preference for ex\-entrepreneurs or ex\-software engineers looking to transition to product. Strong preference for Tier\-1 education background.
* Deep understanding of Tier 2/3 India users (lived experience or strong empathy)



  





**Expertise:** 




  




* Can understand system architecture, and discuss technical trade\-offs with engineers
* Strong data skills \- write SQL, analyze data, understand statistics and A/B testing
* Expert in analytics tools (Mixpanel/Amplitude), SQL, experimentation platforms
* Hypothesis\-driven approach to features and experiments
* Deep understanding of unit economics, LTV:CAC, payback periods
* Mobile\-first DNA with iOS/Android expertise



  





**About the Team at Airblack** 




  





 We are a lean team (under 30 members) with a high curiosity quotient and talent density. We like to partner with highly ambitious people who like to set high benchmarks for themselves, and have backed it up with actions in the past. Current management team:
 



  




* Videt: Founder; Product \& Business; Ex\-Elevation Capital, BCG, NSIT, 2X founder
* Vaibhav: Founder, Engineering; Ex\-Goldman Sachs, IIT Roorkee CS
* Nirmal: Business \& Category; Ex\-Urban Company, Vedanta, IIT Madras
* Harleen: BD \& Culture; Ex\-Spicejet, Education Entrepreneur
* Hrishikesh: Operations, Ex\-Teach for India

title: Project Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Information Security Project Manager**
 Information Security prevents, detects, responds to, and mitigates potential cyber\-risk threats, protects EY and client data, and our information management systems. Thereby reducing overall risk to both EY’s infrastructure and data.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Project Manager is responsible for delivering Information Security IT projects to schedule, budget and quality. The role requires technical knowledge of project management inter\-related process stages i.e. initiate, plan, execute, monitor and control and close, and the supporting processes e.g. scope, cost, time, issue, risk, resource, communication, stakeholder management. Experience in related processes such as portfolio management, program management, methods and tools and quality assurance is preferred. The Project Manager should have stakeholder relationship management experience to successfully support the project team and project stakeholders, and have expertise recognized and requested by customers.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The Project Manager may work under the guidance of a Senior Project Manager (or ESP Leader) in the following areas:
   

  

* Project Planning and Control
+ Maintain very close visibility into and active control over projects to agreed schedule, budget and scope
+ Conduct stage gates at least at the end of plan and before deployment to production

* Resource Management
+ Demonstrate control over the project resource plan
+ Ensure actual work matches the planned effort
+ Actively maintain resource requests and allocations

* Forecasting and Financial Control
+ Maintain accurate project financial forecasts

* Deliverable Quality
+ Ensure project deliverables are fit for purpose

* Risk and Issue Management
+ Proactively recognize risks or issues, and do not wait to respond to them
+ Regularly maintain RAID logs so they can be referenced by any stakeholder
+ Ensure projects are 100% compliant with EY and Information Security delivery standards


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience with project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Track record of customer focus, based on openness, trust, and delivering on promises
* IT background with experience across the systems development life cycle with experience in all project phases – plan, initiate, elaborate, design, build, test, implement.
* Strong team working skills across matrixed client, supplier and globally dispersed virtual teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills – must be able to communicate fluently in English both verbally and in writing


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 3 to 5 years in a corporate IT environment
* 1 to 3 years of experience in project management
* 1 to 3 years of experience with IAM technologies, such as credential vaulting, bastion administrative forests, Federation, Active Directory etc.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management certification is highly preferred (PMI/CAPM or PMP, PRINCE2\)
* Familiarity with ITIL v2 or 3 would be advantageous
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) certifications or other Information Security related a plus
* Experience in EY IT Infrastructure deployments
* Specific experience in EY Information Security \| Enterprise Security Program (and specifically IAM domain) highly preferred


**What We Look For**
* Acting with a sense of ownership and urgency
* Assuming personal accountability for success
* Always looking for solutions to getting things done, rather than reasons why they can’t be done


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 The Project Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end technical implementation, integration, and delivery of Direct Carrier Billing (DCB) platform deployments across telecom operators . The role focuses on execution, integration management, stakeholder coordination, regulatory compliance, and ensuring seamless platform deployment and stabilization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Planning \& Execution** 



* Manage complete lifecycle of DCB platform implementation from requirement gathering to deployment and post\-launch support.
* Define project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and resource planning.
* Prepare detailed project plans, execution schedules, and tracking mechanisms.
* Ensure projects are delivered within defined timelines, scope, and quality benchmarks.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.



  





**2\. Technical Implementation \& Integration** 



* Lead integration of DCB platform with:
* Telecom operator billing systems
* Charging and payment gateways
* Subscription and consent management systems
* Merchant / content provider platforms
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to ensure adherence to technical specifications.
* Review API documentation, integration flows, and system architecture requirements.
* Validate end\-to\-end customer journey including subscription flow, charging flow, and notification mechanisms.



  





**3\. Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Act as the primary implementation interface between telecom operators, technology teams.
* Conduct technical sessions, integration discussions, and requirement alignment sessions.
* Drive regular status meetings, progress reporting, and escalation handling.
* Ensure clear communication between internal and external technical stakeholders.



  





**4\. Compliance \& Governance** 



* Ensure implementation aligns with telecom regulatory frameworks and operator technical guidelines.
* Implement consent frameworks, refund handling workflows, and anti\-fraud safeguards as per operator policies.



  





**5\. Testing \& Quality Assurance** 



* Define and manage UAT plans, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with QA teams and operator technical teams for integration testing.
* Oversee pilot launches and ensure readiness for commercial deployment.



  





**6\. Deployment \& Post\-Launch Stabilization** 



* Manage go\-live execution and production release coordination.
* Monitor platform performance post deployment.
* Handle defect tracking, issue resolution, and change management requests.
* Ensure SLA adherence and operational handover to support teams.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of telecom ecosystem and Direct Carrier Billing workflows.
* Knowledge of telecom billing systems, charging gateways, and subscription platforms.
* Experience with API integrations and payment processing architectures.
* Strong project planning, execution, and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in project management methodologies
* Excellent stakeholder coordination and problem\-solving capabilities.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* On\-time project implementation and deployment success rate
* Integration completion turnaround time
* UAT success ratio and defect resolution efficiency
* Platform stability during post\-launch phase
* Stakeholder implementation satisfaction

title: Scrum Master/Project Manager
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As PM / Scrum Master for Digital Finance, you sit at the intersection of delivery and transformation. You keep agile teams focused, unblocked, and moving — while ensuring that the digitalization projects you oversee are grounded in real finance processes and tied to tangible business outcomes. Your day spans sprint ceremonies, dependency tracking, stakeholder updates, and close collaboration with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Data \& AI/ML Engineers, BI developers, and finance leads across TI’s business units.
   

  

 How You’ll Make an Impact
   

  

* Drive Agile Delivery
+ Facilitate sprint ceremonies — stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives — to ensure effective team collaboration and continuous improvement.
+ Use agile methods to project manage multiple digitalization initiatives simultaneously, maintaining pace and quality across the portfolio.
+ Support teams in keeping project planning tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) up to date — monitoring engagement, status accuracy, and documentation completeness.

* Remove Impediments and Manage Dependencies
+ Proactively identify and remove obstacles that hinder team progress, ensuring smooth workflow and on\-time delivery of project milestones.
+ Identify, track, and manage cross\-team dependencies — communicating potential impacts on timelines early and facilitating alignment on priorities and responsibilities.

* Lead Projects End to End
+ Act as project lead for digitalization initiatives within TI, owning scope definition, milestone planning, and delivery accountability.
+ Support project scope definition, schedule, tasks, and objectives — translating business requirements from the finance domain into structured, executable delivery plans.
+ Enforce strong project governance and delivery discipline (e.g., release frameworks, product lifecycle), ensuring clarity of requirements and preventing scope creep.
+ Drive cross\-functional, interdisciplinary teams across business units, keeping diverse stakeholders aligned and accountable.

* Engage Stakeholders and Support Change
+ Build and maintain effective working relationships with business communities, understanding their operational and informational needs.
+ Provide clear, timely reporting on project status, budget impacts, and objective progress to management and business units.
+ Support change management associated with digital transformation — ensuring teams are prepared and equipped to adopt new processes and technologies.
+ Act as a role model for the digital finance transformation, embodying agile ways of working and a continuous improvement mindset.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Expert\-level project management skills across both agile and classic methodologies, with hands\-on experience running Scrum ceremonies and managing delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Solid understanding of finance processes — record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash — sufficient to engage credibly with finance stakeholders and translate their needs into delivery requirements.
* Working familiarity with enterprise tools such as Alteryx, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, Jira, or Confluence — enough to support teams without being the technical expert in the room.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills — results\-oriented, empathic, and effective as both sender and receiver of complex, multi\-stakeholder information.

* Proficiency in English.
